original: tadihādhyayanasaṃskṛtādvedādanantaprayojanasaṃbhavaṃ tadvicāramantareṇānyatra śāstrābhyājhrbhāṭase kaḥ prayasyediti tātparyam |

original: evamadhyayanavidhirmantravanniyamavadakṣararāśigrahaṇamātre paryavasyati |

original: nanu evaṃ viditopayogenādhyetrā arthajñānamapi vidhiphalatayā svīkāryam; aviditopayogena tu akṣaragrahaṇamapi na phalatvena pratipattuṃ śakyam; ato'nuṣṭhānaṃ pratyavyavahitopayuktamarthajñānamapi grahaṇavadadhyayanavidherdṛṣṭaṃ phalamastviti śaṅkā prastutopasaṃhāravyājena pratikṣipati -- evam iti | vidheyasvarūpaphalādinirūpaṇaprakā reṇetyarthaḥ |

original: mantravattvaṃ niyamavattvaṃ ca anūñcāraṇasthaṃ tatphale gṛhītāvupacaritam | mantrāḥ -- kāṇḍavratādyaṅgabhūtāḥ, adhyayanadaśājapyāśca śaṃ no mitraḥ ityādyāḥ | niyamāḥ -- prāguktāḥ | mantravadityetat dṛṣṭāntoktirityeke -- yathā mantre codyamānamadhyayanamakṣaragrahaṇamātraparyavasāyīti svīkriyate, tathehāpīti |
analyzed: mantravat tvam niyamavat tvam ca tad phale gṛhītau upacaritam mantrāḥ kāṇḍavrata ādi aṅga bhūtāḥ adhyayana daśā japyāḥ ca śam naḥ mitraḥ ityādyāḥ niyamāḥ prāk uktāḥ mantra vat iti etat dṛṣṭānta uktiḥ iti eke yathā mantre codyamānam adhyayanam akṣara grahaṇa mātra paryavasāyi iti svīkriyate tathā iha api iti

original: apare tu -- yathopanayanadaśoñcaraṇīyeṣūpanītamātrasya samidādhānādimantreṣu ca, tathehāpīti veditavyamiti | humādivadityanye, viṣaharaṇādimantraviśeṣavaditi ca | mātracā paryavasānaśabdena cākṣaragrahaṇātpaścātpūrvaṃ ca vidhiviśrāntirniṣidhyate |

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- adhyayanaśabdasya na tāvadarthajñānavācakatvam, avyutpatteḥ, kiñcidadhītya brāhmaṇa ityādau ca tasyārthaparatvāsaṃbhavāñca | vidhiviṣayamadhyayanaṃ pratyavyavahitasādhyamabhivyāptamavarjanīyaṃ ca phalaṃ dṛśyate |

analyzed: tad anyasya api tad phalatva klṛptau gauravam syāt vyavahita sādhyasya api phalatva klṛptau jñāna vat tad sādhyasya anuṣṭhānasya api tad klṛpti prasaṅgaḥ uttara vidhi avyavahita apekṣita tvam api grahaṇa jñānayoḥ samam yadi ca artha jñānam karma viṣaya tayā āmnātam tadā tu avyāpini vyavahite api tasmin saṃpratyayaḥ syāt na tu etat asti

original: ato'rthadhiya upayogitayaiva svīkāryā iti |

original: nanu samanvayādhikaraṇanyāyādarthajñānasyaiva svataḥ prayojanatayā phalatvaklṛptiryuktā ;

original: mevam; niratiśayānandabrahmapratipādakabhāgamātre tadukteḥ atra tu kṛtsnādhyayanaphalavimarśāt virūpaklṛptyayogāñca | nanu bṛddhavākyāni śruṇu ityādau vākyaśravaṇavigherarthadhīparyantatvaṃ lokadṛṣṭamiti cenna, vṛkṣādivanmārgalakṣaṇabhūtasya kasyacidvākyasya śrotavyatvopadeśe tātparyāttadabhāvasyāpi dṛṣṭeḥ |
analyzed: niratiśaya ānanda brahma pratipādaka bhāga mātre tad ukteḥ atra tu kṛtsna adhyayana phala vimarśāt virūpa klṛpti ayogāt ca nanu bṛddha vākyāni śruṇu ityādau vākya śravaṇa vigheḥ artha dhī paryanta tvam loka dṛṣṭam iti ced na vṛkṣa ādi vat mārga lakṣaṇa bhūtasya kasyacid vākyasya śrotavya tva upadeśe tātparyāt tad abhāvasya api dṛṣṭeḥ

original: yadyapyakṣayaphalatvamidaṃ vidyāṅgatvena paraṃparayā netuṃ śakyam, tathā'pyatra tadvivakṣāvirahānna tathā nīyate | evaṃ parimitaphalasomahaviṣkarmasvarūpaniścaye satyeva apāma somamityādāvamṛtatvasya ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ sthānamamṛtatvamityādismṛtyā niyamaḥ |
analyzed: yadi api akṣaya phalatvam idam vidyā aṅgatvena paraṃparayā netum śakyam tathā api atra tad vivakṣā virahāt na tathā nīyate evam parimita phala soma haviṣkarma svarūpa niścaye sati eva apāma somam ityādau amṛta tvasya ābhūtasaṃplavam sthānam amṛta tvam ityādi smṛtyā niyamaḥ

original: svargasvārājyādiphalabhedasādhakakarmasvarūpabhedasiddhau ca tatra svargaśabdoktasyālpatvasiddhiḥ | yaṃ yaṃ kratumadhīta ityādiṣu ca phalatāratamyaklṛptiḥ gurulaghukarmasvarūpaniścayādeva | utpattināśavadārādhyaprīṇanakarmasvarūpaniścayāñca tatsādhyasya tatsāyujyā derasthiratvadṛṣṭiriti |
analyzed: svarga svārājya ādi phala bheda sādhaka karma svarūpa bheda siddhau ca tatra svarga śabda uktasya alpatva siddhiḥ yam yam kratum adhīte ityādiṣu ca phala tāratamya klṛptiḥ guru laghu karma sva rūpa niścayāt eva utpatti nāśa vat ārādhya prīṇana karma sva rūpa niścayāt ca tad sādhyasya tad sāyujya ādeḥ asthira tva dṛṣṭiḥ iti

original: tadevaṃ nirastapratibandhabrahmavicārārthasya śārīrakasya vidyāsthānāntaravyāvṛttasvarūpaphalābhyāṃ mīmāṃsaikadeśatvavyaktyarthaṃ nirṇetavyaviśeṣasiddhyarthaṃ ca punaḥ
analyzed: tat evam nirasta pratibandha brahma vicāra arthasya śārīrakasya vidyā sthāna antara vyāvṛtta svarūpa phalābhyām mīmāṃsā eka deśa tva vyakti artham nirṇetavya viśeṣa siddhi artham ca punar

original: adhyayane tyādikamuktam | atrāmṛtatvaśabdena trayyantapradhānavedyaphaloktiḥ; tenārvācīnānāmānuṣaṅgikānnavattvādīnāṃ saṅgatyantaraghaṭitadṛṣṭividhyādiphalānāṃ ca vyavacchedaḥ | karmabhāgoktamamṛtatvamāpekṣikaṃ sādhitam |
analyzed: adhyayane tyādikam uktam atra amṛta tva śabdena trayī anta pradhāna vedya phala uktiḥ tena arvācīnānām ānuṣaṅgika annavat tva ādīnām saṅgati antara ghaṭita dṛṣṭi vidhi ādi phalānām ca vyavacchedaḥ karma bhāga uktam amṛta tvam āpekṣikam sādhitam

original: idaṃ tu bādhādarśanāt nirṇītāṃsasaṃvādivedāntaikadeśopaṣṭambhāñca na prācyavaditi pratyāyitaprāyamityabhiprāyeṇa anantasthiraphalāpātapratīterityuktam | na hyatra phalatvādyanumānaiḥ alpāsthiratvādiklṛptiḥ śakyā, atiprasaṅgāditi | anavacchedādiha sarvaśarīraḥ śārīraḥ, tamadhikṛtya pravṛttaṃ śāstraṃ śārīrakam |
analyzed: idam tu bādhā darśanāt nirṇīta aṃsa saṃvādi vedānta eka deśa upaṣṭambhāt ca na prācya vat iti pratyāyita prāyam iti abhiprāyeṇa ananta sthira phala āpāta pratīteḥ iti uktam na hi atra phala tva ādi anumānaiḥ alpa asthira tva ādi klṛptiḥ śakyā atiprasaṅgāt iti anavacchedāt iha sarva śarīraḥ śārīraḥ tam adhikṛtya pravṛttam śāstram śārīrakam

original: vakṣyati hi ānandamayādhikaraṇe -- sa eva nirupādhikaḥ śārīra ātmā | ata evedaṃ paraṃ brahmādhikṛtya pravṛttaṃ śāstraṃ śārīrakamityabhiyuktairabhidhīyata iti | saiva mīmāṃseti śārīkamīmāṃsā; tasyām | adhikaroti svārthabuddhyā tatrodyukto bhavati, na tu pūrvavṛttāntarādadhikarotītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: vakṣyati hi ānanda maya adhikaraṇe saḥ eva nirupādhikaḥ śārīraḥ ātmā atas eva idam param brahma adhikṛtya pravṛttam śāstram śārīrakam iti abhiyuktaiḥ abhidhīyate iti sā eva mīmāṃsā iti śārīkamīmāṃsā tasyām adhikaroti svārtha buddhyā tatra udyuktaḥ bhavati na tu pūrva vṛtta antarāt adhikaroti iti arthaḥ

original: brahmavicārānantarye yuktisiddhe tadviṣayaśāstrānantaryamapi sidhyediti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: brahma vicāra ānantarye yukti siddhe tad viṣaya śāstra ānantaryam api sidhyet iti bhāvaḥ

original: grahaṇaṃ ca phalatvaṃ ca sārthatā ca svataḥ śruteḥ |
analyzed: grahaṇam ca phala tvam ca sārtha tā ca svatas śruteḥ

original: rāgātkṛtsnavicāraścetyapūrvamiha bhāṣitam || 284 ||
analyzed: rāgāt kṛtsna vicāraḥ ca itya pūrvam iha bhāṣitam

original: tathā ca vedāntavākyāni kevalakarmaphalasya kṣayitvaṃ brahmajñānasya cākṣayaphalatvaṃ darśayanti | tadyatheha karmācito lokaḥ kṣīyate, evamevāmutra puṇyacito lokaḥ kṣīyate | antavadevāsya tadbhavati | na hyadhruvaiḥ prāpyate | plavā hyete adṛḍhā yajñarūpāḥ parīkṣya lokān karmacitān brāhmaṇo nirvedamāyānnāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtena |
analyzed: tathā ca vedānta vākyāni kevala karma phalasya kṣayi tvam brahma jñānasya ca akṣaya phalatvam darśayanti tat yathā iha karma ācitaḥ lokaḥ kṣīyate evam eva amutra puṇya citaḥ lokaḥ kṣīyate antavat eva asya tat bhavati na hi adhruvaiḥ prāpyate plavāḥ hi ete adṛḍhāḥ yajña rūpāḥ parīkṣya lokān karma citān brāhmaṇaḥ nirvedam āyāt na asti akṛtaḥ kṛtena

original: tadvijñānārthaṃ sa gurumevābhigacchet samitpāṇiśśrotriyaṃ brahmaniṣṭham | tasmai sa vidvānupasannāya samyak praśāntacittāya śamānvitāya | yenākṣaraṃ puruṣaṃ veda satyaṃ provāca tāṃ tattvato brahmavidyām |
analyzed: tad vijñāna artham sa gurum eva abhigacchet samidh pāṇiḥ śrotriyam brahma niṣṭham tasmai sa vidvān upasannāya samyak praśānta cittāya śama anvitāya yena akṣaram puruṣam veda satyam provāca tām tattvataḥ brahma vidyām

original: brahmavidāpnoti param, na punarmṛtyave tadekaṃ paśyati na paśyo mṛtyuṃ paśyati, sa svarāṅ bhavati, tamevaṃ vidvānamṛta iha bhavati, nānyaḥ panthā ayanāya vidyate, pṛthagātmānaṃ
analyzed: brahma vidā āpnoti param na punarmṛtyave tat ekam paśyati na paśyaḥ mṛtyum paśyati sa svarāj bhavati tam evam vidvān amṛtaḥ iha bhavati na anyaḥ panthāḥ ayanāya vidyate pṛthak ātmānam

original: preritāraṃ ca matvā juṣṭastatastenāmṛtatvameti ityādīni |
analyzed: preritāram ca matvā juṣṭaḥ tatas tena amṛta tvam eti ityādīni

original: nanu karmaphalālpatvādau liṅgamātraṃ dṛṣṭam; yathāśrutaviruddhapratyayadārḍhyāya prāptirapi vaktavyā, karmasvarupanirūpaṇaṃ cātra svayaṃpravṛtteḥ pratibandhaśāntartham; hetustvanantasthiraphalāpātapratītireva, sā kutastyetrāha -- tathā iti | uktaprakāreṇāsya sūtrasyāpyaidamarthyaṃ yathā syāttathetyarthaḥ | caḥ avadhāraṇe |
analyzed: nanu karma phala alpatva ādau liṅga mātram dṛṣṭam yathāśruta viruddha pratyaya dārḍhyāya prāptiḥ api vaktavyā karma svarupa nirūpaṇam ca atra svayaṃpravṛtteḥ pratibandha śānta artham hetuḥ tu ananta sthira phala āpāta pratītiḥ eva sā kutastya itra āha tathā iti ukta prakāreṇa asya sūtrasya api aidamarthyam yathā syāt tathā iti arthaḥ caḥ avadhāraṇe

original: atra kṣatitvoktirakṣayitvoktiścālpatvāderupalakṣikā | niścitasaṃvādenāniścite'rthāntare'pi śraddhāsaṃvṛddhyai pūrvaṃ tadyathetyādivākyodāhṛtiḥ | loko lokyaḥ, bhogyaḥ | deśaparatve tvihāmutretyābhyāmananvayaḥ | karmacitaḥ laukikakarmalabdhaḥ |
analyzed: atra kṣati tva uktiḥ akṣayi tva uktiḥ ca alpatva ādeḥ upalakṣikā niścita saṃvādena aniścita irtha antare pi śraddhā saṃvṛddhyai pūrvam tat yathā ityādi vākya udāhṛtiḥ lokaḥ lokyaḥ bhogyaḥ deśa paratve tu iha amutra ityābhyām ananvayaḥ karma citaḥ laukika karma labdhaḥ

original: puṇyacita ityaviśeṣoktyā nivṛttidharmasādhyasyāpi kṣayitvabhramaṃ nivārayitumāha -- antavat iti | upāttavākyai kārthyāt kriyāsvarūpāntavattvasyānapekṣitavacanatvāñca phaladvārā'trāntattvoktiḥ |
analyzed: puṇya citaḥ iti aviśeṣa uktyā nivṛtti dharma sādhyasya api kṣayi tva bhramam nivārayitum āha antavat iti upātta vākyaiḥ kārthyāt kriyā svarūpa antavat tvasya anapekṣita vacana tvāt ca phala dvārā atra anta tva uktiḥ

original: yo vā etadakṣaraṃ gārgyaviditvā'smin loke juhoti yajate tapastapyate bahūni varṣasahasrāṇīti pūrvavākyāt yo vā etadakṣaraṃ gārgyaviditvā'smāllokātpraiti sa kṛpaṇa ityuttaravākyāñca; antavadityasya brahmavedanarahitakarmaviṣayatvasiddhau puṇyacitaḥ ityatrottareṣu ca tadviṣayatvaṃ sugamam |
analyzed: yaḥ vai etat akṣaram gārgi a viditvā asmin loke juhoti yajate tapaḥ tapyate bahūni varṣa sahasrāṇi iti pūrva vākyāt yaḥ vai etat akṣaram gārgi a viditvā asmāt lokāt praiti sa kṛpaṇaḥ iti uttara vākyāt ca antavat iti asya brahma vedana rahita karma viṣaya tva siddhau puṇya citaḥ iti atra uttareṣu ca tad viṣaya tvam sugamam

original: jñānarahitakarmasu svargasvārājyādiphalabhedavat keṣucinnityaphalabhedasaṃbhavāt sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo jyotiṣṭoma iti śravaṇāñcatropāttaṃ vākyaṃ prāyikaviṣayaṃ syādityātrāha -- na hīti | adhruvaiḥ adhruvaphalasādhanatayā coditairityarthaḥ | dhruvaṃ taditi vākyakhaṇḍānvayāt nityaphalārthatvābhāvaḥ ravyāpyate |
analyzed: jñāna rahita karmasu svarga svārājya ādi phala bheda vat keṣucid nitya phala bheda saṃbhavāt sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyaḥ jyotiṣṭomaḥ iti śravaṇāt catra upāttam vākyam prāyika viṣayam syāt iti ātra āha na hi iti adhruvaiḥ adhruva phala sādhanatayā coditaiḥ iti arthaḥ dhruvam tat iti vākya khaṇḍa anvayāt nitya phala artha tva abhāvaḥ

original: punarāvṛttiniyamavataḥ sarvakarmanirmūlanatvāyogena dhruvaphalasādhanatvābhāvaṃ draḍhati -- plavā iti | adṛḍhāḥ tamasaḥ pāraṃ gamayitumakṣamāḥ | aṣṭādaśoktamavaraṃ yeṣu karma | etacchreyo ye'bhinandanti mūḍhāḥ jarāmṛtyū te punarevāpi yanti | iti hyatra vākyadeṣaḥ |
analyzed: punarāvṛtti niyamavataḥ sarva karma nirmūlana tva ayogena dhruva phala sādhana tva abhāvam draḍhati plavāḥ iti adṛḍhāḥ tamasaḥ pāram gamayitum akṣamāḥ aṣṭādaśa uktam avaram yeṣu karma etat śreyaḥ mūḍhāḥ jarā mṛtyū te punar eva api yanti iti hi atra vākya deṣaḥ

original: atha sūtrārthānuguṇaṃ karmaṇāṃ nityaphalasādhanatvābhāvaniścayasya nirvedahetutvaṃ brahmajñānasyānantaphalatvaṃ ca samuñcitya vadadvākyamāha -- parī kṣyeti |
analyzed: atha sūtra artha anuguṇam karmaṇām nitya phala sādhanatva abhāva niścayasya nirveda hetutvam brahma jñānasya ananta phalatvam ca samuñcitya vadat vākyam āha parī kṣya iti

original: iyaṃ śrutiḥ sāre vyāravyātā -- brāhmaṇaḥ -- vedābhyāsarataḥ, karmacitān -- karmaṇā saṃpāditān, lokān ārādhyakṣayitvena kṣayasvabhāvān, karmamīmāṃsayā parīkṣya, akṛtaḥ -- nityaḥ paramapuruṣaḥ, kṛtena -- karmaṇā nāsti na saṃpadyata iti yo nirvedamāyāt, sa tadvijñānārthaṃ gurumevābhigacchet samitpāṇiḥ śrotriyaṃ -- vedāntavedinam, brahmaniṣṭhaṃ
analyzed: iyam śrutiḥ sāre brāhmaṇaḥ veda abhyāsa rataḥ karma citān karmaṇā saṃpāditān lokān ārādhya kṣayi tvena kṣaya svabhāvān karma mīmāṃsayā parīkṣya akṛtaḥ nityaḥ paramapuruṣaḥ kṛtena karmaṇā na asti na saṃpadyate iti yaḥ nirvedam āyāt sa tad vijñāna artham gurum eva abhigacchet samidh pāṇiḥ śrotriyam vedānta vedinam brahma niṣṭham anupraviṣṭam anupraviṣṭam anupraviṣṭam anupraviṣṭam anupraviṣṭam anupraviṣṭam anupravi

original: sākṣātkṛtaparamapuruṣasvarūpam | sa ca guruḥ samyagupasannāya tasmai, yena vidyāvi śeṣeṇa tama kṣaraṃ satyaṃ paramapuruṣaṃ vidyāt, tāṃ brahmavidyām provāca prabrūyādityarthaḥ | sa gurumevābhigacchet tasmai sa vidvān provācetyananvayāt, aprāptatvāñca | vidhāvapi liṭo vidhānāt; chandasi luṅlaṅliṭa iti, iti |
analyzed: sākṣātkṛta paramapuruṣa svarūpam sa ca guruḥ samyak upasannāya tasmai yena śeṣeṇa akṣaram satyam paramapuruṣam vidyāt tām brahma vidyām provāca prabrūyāt iti arthaḥ sa gurum eva abhigacchet tasmai sa vidvān provāca iti ananvayāt aprāpta tvāt ca vidhau api liṭaḥ vidhānāt chandasi luṅ laṅ liṭaḥ iti iti

original: atra nyāyasiddhānuvādāṃśe jātivācino'pi brāhmaṇaśabdasya prakṛtakarmaparīkṣaṇaupayikasāṅgādhyetṛsamarpaṇenājahallakṣaṇayā traivarṇikaviṣayatvārthaṃ vedābhyāsarataḥ ityuktam | brahma aṇatītyapi brāhmaṇaśabdaṃ nirbruvanti | ārādhyakṣayitveneti sukṛtavināsopalakṣaṇam | karmamīmāṃsayetyarthalabhyoktiḥ |
analyzed: atra nyāyasiddha anuvāda aṃśe jāti vācinaḥ api brāhmaṇa śabdasya prakṛta karma parīkṣaṇa aupayika sāṅga adhyetṛ samarpaṇena ajahat lakṣaṇayā traivarṇika viṣaya tva artham veda abhyāsa rataḥ iti uktam brahma aṇati iti api brāhmaṇa śabdam nirbruvanti ārādhya kṣayi tvena iti sukṛta vināsa upalakṣaṇam karma mīmāṃsayā iti artha labhya uktiḥ

original: akṛtaśabdasya puṃliṅgatānurodhāt vākyaśeṣaśaktyā ca paramapuruṣo viśeṣyo darśitaḥ | atra nāstiśabdenākṛtasya svarūpaniṣedhāyogāt karmaṇā ityanena cānanvayāt utpattiniṣedhasyānapekṣitatvāt tasya viśadabodhāyetyarthaḥ | samitpāṇitvamiha brahma
analyzed: akṛta śabdasya puṃliṅga tā anurodhāt vākyaśeṣa śaktyā ca paramapuruṣaḥ viśeṣyaḥ darśitaḥ atra nāsti śabdena akṛtasya svarūpa niṣedha ayogāt karmaṇā iti anena ca ananvayāt utpatti niṣedhasya anapekṣita tvāt tasya viśada bodhāya iti arthaḥ samidh pāṇi tvam iha brahma

original: vidyāśravaṇārthopanayanāntaravyañjanārthamiti kecit | uktaṃ hi chāndogye jābālaṃ prati gautamena -- naitadabrāhmaṇo vivaktumarhati samidhaṃ somyāharopa tvāneṣya iti | anyetvāhuḥ -- anupanīte jābāle yuktamupanayanam; anyatra tu samitpāṇitvoktirariktapāṇitvopalakṣaṇārthā;
analyzed: vidyā śravaṇa artha upanayana antara vyañjana artham iti kecid uktam hi chāndogye jābālam prati gautamena na etat abrāhmaṇaḥ vivaktum arhati samidham somya āhara upa tvā aneṣye iti anye tu āhuḥ anupanīte jābāle yuktam upanayanam anyatra tu samidh pāṇi tva uktiḥ arikta pāṇi tva upalakṣaṇa arthā

original: dṛśyate hi vaiśvānaravidyāyām -- te ha samitpāṇayaḥ pūrvāhṇe ca praticakramire tān hānupanīyaivaitaduvāca iti | prajāpativākye ca ekasyaivendrasya bahuṣu praśneṣu samitpāṇiḥ punareyāyetyāvartyate | na hi tatra bahuvāramupanayanaṃ dṛṣṭamiṣṭaṃ vā | sūtrakāraśca saṃskāraparāmarśādityetāvanmātraṃ vakṣyatīti |
analyzed: dṛśyate hi vaiśvānara vidyāyām te ha samidh pāṇayaḥ pūrvāhṇe ca praticakramire tān ha an upanīya eva etat uvāca iti prajāpati vākye ca ekasya eva indrasya bahuṣu praśneṣu samidh pāṇiḥ punar eyāya iti āvartyate na hi tatra bahu vāram upanayanam dṛṣṭam iṣṭam vā sūtrakāraḥ ca saṃskāra parāmarśāt iti etāvat mātram vakṣyati iti

original: ekāṃ śākhāmadhītya śrotriya ityuktasyādhītasvādhyāyamātrasya prakṛtānupakārakatayā vedāntavedinamiti śrotriyaśabdasyātrākāmahataśrotriyaparatvaṃ darśitam | sphuṭapravacanakṣamatvamadṛṣṭata upakārakatamatvaṃ ca brahmaniṣṭhaśabdābhipretamityāha -- sākṣātkṛtaparamapuruṣasvarūpamiti |
analyzed: ekām śākhām adhītya śrotriyaḥ iti uktasya adhīta svādhyāya mātrasya prakṛta an upakāraka tayā vedānta vedinam iti śrotriya śabdasya atra a kāma hata śrotriya paratvam darśitam sphuṭa pravacana kṣamatvam adṛṣṭataḥ upakārakatamatvam ca brahma niṣṭha śabda abhipretam iti āha sākṣātkṛta paramapuruṣa svarūpam iti

original: praśāntacittāyetyuktatvācchamo'tra bāhyakaraṇavyāpārāntaranivṛttiḥ | śamadamāviha śravaṇaupayikāvadhānārthau | tasmādevaṃvicchānto dānta ityādau tu śravaṇato viditārthasya vidyārthau | yenetyatra liṅgavyatyayasya kliṣṭatvātsāmānyopakramatvaṃ dyotayati -- vidyāviśeṣaṇeti |
analyzed: praśānta cittāya iti ukta tvāt śamaḥ utra bāhya karaṇa vyāpāra antara nivṛttiḥ śama damau iha śravaṇa aupayika avadhāna arthau tasmāt evaṃvid śāntaḥ dāntaḥ ityādau tu śravaṇataḥ vidita arthasya vidyā arthau yena iti atra liṅga vyatyayasya kliṣṭa tvāt sāmānya upakrama tvam dyotayati vidyā viśeṣaṇa iti

original: tathā ca prayuñjate tatra bādhakamabhavat kṣaṇabhaṅgo vā bāhyārthabhaṅgo vā ityādi | svarūpataḥ svabhāvataśca vikāraṃ nivartayadbhyāmakṣarasatyapadābhyāṃ pradhānakṣetrajñavyavaccheda ityabhiprāyeṇāha -- paramapuruṣamiti | saṃśayaviparyayārhavacanam, apūrṇavacanaṃ ca kṣeptuṃ tattvataḥ iti viśeṣaṇam;
analyzed: tathā ca prayuñjate tatra bādhakam abhavat kṣaṇa bhaṅgaḥ vā bāhya artha bhaṅgaḥ vā ityādi svarūpataḥ svabhāvataḥ ca vikāram nivartayadbhyām akṣara satya padābhyām pradhāna kṣetrajña vyavacchedaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha paramapuruṣam iti saṃśaya viparyaya arha vacanam apūrṇa vacanam ca kṣeptum tattvataḥ iti viśeṣaṇam

original: ācāryo'pyanācāryo bhavati śrutātpariharamāṇa iti smaranti | vṛttārthakathanabhrabhanirāsāyāha -- prabrūyāditi | abhigacchedityupakramapratītavidhibādhena vyatyayānusaraṇaṃ kliṣṭam; ataḥ provācetyasya bhūtaparatvenānanvaya ityabhiprāyeṇāha -- sa gurumeveti | niyamavidhitvamavadhāraṇena vyañjitam | provācetyasya
analyzed: ācāryaḥ upi anācāryaḥ bhavati śrutāt pariharamāṇaḥ iti smaranti vṛtta artha kathana bhrabha nirāsāya āha prabrūyāt iti abhigacchet iti upakrama pratīta vidhi bādhena vyatyaya anusaraṇam kliṣṭam atas provāca ityasya bhūta paratvena ananvayaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha sa gurum eva iti niyama vidhi tvam avadhāraṇena vyañjitam provāca ityasya

original: vidhiparatve hetvantaramāha -- aprāptatvāditi | yadyapi lābhādyapekṣayā kasyacidrāgataḥ pravṛttiḥ; tathā'pi tannirapekṣasya guroḥ sacchiṣyaviṣaye dharmārthamidaṃ vidhīyata iti na virodhaḥ | liṭo liṅarthatvasya viśeṣato'nuśiṣṭatva mapyāha -- vidhāvapīti |
analyzed: vidhi paratve hetu antaram āha aprāptatvāt iti yadi api lābha ādi apekṣayā kasyacid rāgataḥ pravṛttiḥ tathā api tad nirapekṣasya guroḥ sat śiṣya viṣaye dharma artham idam vidhīyate iti na virodhaḥ liṭaḥ liṅ artha tvasya viśeṣataḥ nuśiṣṭa tvam api āha vidhau api iti

original: brahmajñānasya paraśabdanirdiṣṭabrahmaprāpakatayā prākaraṇikanityaniratiśayānandaprāpakatvamabhipretyāha -- brahmavidi ti | brahma prāptasyāpi svargādinyāyāt imān lokānityādibhiśca punarāvṛttyādiśaṅkāṃ parihartumāha -- na puna riti | mṛtyuriha maraṇam, moho mṛtyussaṃmato yaḥ kavīnāmityādyuktaṃ vā |
analyzed: brahma jñānasya para śabda nirdiṣṭa brahma prāpaka tayā prākaraṇika nitya niratiśaya ānanda prāpaka tvam abhipretya āha brahma vidi ti brahma prāptasya api svarga ādi nyāyāt imān lokān iti ādibhiḥ ca punarāvṛtti ādi śaṅkām parihartum āha na punar iti mṛtyuḥ iha maraṇam mohaḥ mṛtyuḥ saṃmataḥ yaḥ kavīnām ityādi uktam vā

original: pāpmanāṃ niśśeṣakṣaye mṛtyūpalakṣitaṃ sarvamaniṣṭaṃ na syāt, lokānusaraṇaṃ caicchamiti bhāvaḥ | tadekadarśanamihopāyaḥ, phalaṃ vā | na pretya saṃjñāstīti yidyāprakaraṇa
analyzed: pāpmanām niśśeṣa kṣaye mṛtyu upalakṣitam sarvam aniṣṭam na syāt loka anusaraṇam ca aiccham iti bhāvaḥ tad eka darśanam iha upāyaḥ phalam vā na pretya saṃjñā asti iti

original: sthavākyena muktasya jñānalopaśaṅkāṃ nivartayan mṛtyutatkāryanivṛtiṃta ca vyanakti -- na paśya iti | muktasya tadātanaparaduḥkhaprāktanasvaduḥkhadarśane'pi tayoḥ svāśritatvavartamānatvābhāvānna taṃ prati pratikūlatvam | evaṃ hi bandhadaśāyāmapi dṛṣṭam | tatra tu paraduḥkhaduḥkhitvaṃ, gatānuśocanaṃ ca karmopādhikameva;
analyzed: stha vākyena muktasya jñāna lopa śaṅkām nivartayan ca vyanakti na paśye iti muktasya tadātana para duḥkha prāktana sva duḥkha darśane api tayoḥ sva āśrita tva vartamāna tva abhāvāt na tam prati pratikūla tvam evam hi bandha daśāyām api dṛṣṭam tatra tu para duḥkha duḥkhi tvam gatānuśocanam ca karma upādhikam eva

original: na rogaṃ nota duḥkhatāṃ sarvaṃ ha paśyaḥ paśyatītyādinā viśeṣeṇa dṛśyamāneṣvapi svaprātikūlyadarśanaṃ nāstīti hi sthāpyate | paśyo'tra tadekaṃ paśyatīti samānaprakaraṇāt brahmadarśī jīvaḥ | paśyatīti vyutpattyā paramātmanyapi, paśyaḥ paśyati paśyantamityādiprayogadṛṣṭeḥ | brahmātmakatayā sarvasya darśanāttadekadarśanasarvadarśanayoḥ na virodhaḥ |
analyzed: na rogam na uta duḥkhatām sarvam ha paśyaḥ paśyati ityādinā viśeṣeṇa dṛśyamāneṣu api sva prātikūlya darśanam na asti iti hi sthāpyate paśyaḥ utra tat ekam paśyati iti samāna prakaraṇāt brahma darśī jīvaḥ paśyati iti vyutpattyā paramātmani api paśyaḥ paśyati paśyantam ityādi prayoga dṛṣṭeḥ brahma ātmaka tayā sarvasya darśanāt tad eka darśana sarva darśanayoḥ na virodhaḥ

original: na kevalaṃ nirvyāpārasārvajñyamātram, anyarājānaste kṣayyalokā bhavantītyāmnātakarmamūlānīśvarapāratantryanivṛttyā svacchandavṛttiśca syādityabhipretyāha -- sa svarāḍi ti | ata eveśvarapāratantryasthitāvapi svarāṭ svatantra iti naighaṇṭukoktirna virudhyate |
analyzed: na kevalam nirvyāpāra sārvajñya mātram anya rājānaḥ te kṣayya lokāḥ bhavanti iti āmnāta karma mūla anīśvara pāratantrya nivṛttyā svacchanda vṛttiḥ ca syāt iti abhipretya āha sa svarāj i ti atas eva īśvara pāratantrya sthitau api svarāj svatantraḥ iti naighaṇṭuka uktiḥ na virudhyate

original: amṛtatvamyopāyāntaraniṣedhaśrutyā karmasādhyāmṛtatvokteranyaparatvaṃ draḍhayati -- tamevami ti | atra ca guṇavibhūtiviśiṣṭamahāpuruṣaparāmarśājjīvasyaiva nirviśeṣasvarūpadhiyā puruṣāntaradhiyā vā muktiḥ syāditi pareṣṭaṃ nirastam | aikyabhedābhedabuddhyoramṛtatvahetutvaṃ śrutyaiva kṣiptamityāha -- pṛthagi ti |
analyzed: amṛta tva mya upāya antara niṣedha śrutyā karma sādhya amṛta tva ukteḥ anya paratvam draḍhayati tam evam iti atra ca guṇa vibhūti viśiṣṭa mahāpuruṣa parāmarśāt jīvasya eva nirviśeṣa svarūpa dhiyā puruṣa antara dhiyā vā muktiḥ syāt iti para iṣṭam nirastam aikya bheda abheda buddhyoḥ amṛta tva hetutvam śrutyā eva kṣiptam iti āha pṛthak iti

original: tataḥ upāsanarūpāt pṛthaktvamananādityarthaḥ | tena juṣṭaḥ -- prerakeṇa prītiviṣayīkṛtaḥ | anena sthirasya parānugrahasyaiva phaladvāratoktiḥ | dhātuḥ prasādāditi ca śrūyate | nanvatrātmānaṃ preritāraṃ ceti samuccityamananamuktam; ato'nyajñānasyāpi mokṣahetutvaṃ bhāti; satyam, na tāvatā prerakaprādhānyamapahniyate |
analyzed: tatas upāsana rūpāt pṛthaktva mananāt iti arthaḥ tena juṣṭaḥ prerakeṇa prīti viṣayīkṛtaḥ anena sthirasya para anugrahasya eva phala dvāra tā uktiḥ dhātuḥ prasādāt iti ca śrūyate nanu atra ātmānam preritāram ca iti samuccitya mananam uktam atonya jñānasya api mokṣa hetu tvam bhāti satyam na tāvatā preraka prādhānyam apahniyate

original: kaściddhīraḥ pratyagātmānamaikṣat āvṛttacakṣuramṛtatvamicchannityādāvapi paravidyāṅgajīvadarśanaparam | ādiśabdaḥ bhūyasāṃ syādbalīyastvamiti nyāyena vākyāntarairapyuktadṛḍhīkaraṇārthaḥ |
analyzed: kaścid dhīraḥ pratyagātmānam aikṣat āvṛtta cakṣuḥ amṛta tvam icchan ityādau api para vidyā aṅga jīva darśana param ādi śabdaḥ bhūyasām syāt balīyaḥ tvam iti nyāyena vākya antaraiḥ api ukta dṛḍhīkaraṇa arthaḥ

original: nanu ca sāṅgavedādhyayanādeva karmaṇāṃ svargādiphalatvaṃ svargādīnāṃ ca kṣayitvaṃ brahmopāsanasyāmṛtatvaphalatvaṃ ca jñāyata eva | anantaraṃ mumukṣuḥ brahmajijñāsāyāmeva pravartatām | kimarthā dharmavicārāpekṣā | evaṃ tarhi śārīrakamīmāṃsāyāmapi na pravartatām, sāṅgādhyayanādeva kṛtsnasya jñātatvāt | satyam;
analyzed: nanu ca sa aṅga veda adhyayanāt eva karmaṇām svarga ādi phalatvam svarga ādīnām ca kṣayi tvam brahma upāsanasya amṛta tva phalatvam ca jñāyate eva anantaram mumukṣuḥ brahma jijñāsāyām eva pravartatām kimarthā dharma vicāra apekṣā evam tarhi śārīraka mīmāṃsāyām api na pravartatām sa aṅga adhyayanāt eva kṛtsnasya jñāta tvāt satyam

original: āpātapratītirvidyata eva, tathā'pi nyāyānugṛhītasya vākyasyārthaniścāyakatvādāpātapratīto'pyarthaḥ saṃśayaviparyayau nātivartate; atastannirṇayāya vedāntavākyavicāraḥ kartavya iti cet, tathaiva dharmavicāro'pi kartavya iti paśyatu bhavān |
analyzed: āpāta pratītiḥ vidyate eva tathā api nyāya anugṛhītasya vākyasya artha niścāyaka tvāt āpāta pratītaḥ api arthaḥ saṃśaya viparyayau na ativartate atas tad nirṇayāya vedānta vākya vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti ced tathā eva dharma vicāraḥ api kartavyaḥ iti paśyatu bhavān

original: gaḍḍhandya ghddhaḍḍhadhtdṛdvadma nanvajñānādipratyanīkasvamātraprakāśe nirviśeṣe nityamukte brahmaṇi kathamavidyātirodhānabhedadarśanabandhatannivṛttinivartakādīnāṃ saṃbhavaḥ ? karmakṛtasya bandhasya niṣkṛtinayāt karmaviśeṣa eva nivartakaḥ syāt | nivartakajñānaṃ ca tato jñānaṃ pravartata iti smaraṇāt karmasādhyam |
analyzed: nanu ajñāna ādi pratyanīka sva mātra prakāśe nirviśeṣe nitya mukte brahmaṇi katham avidyā tirodhāna bheda darśana bandha tad nivṛtti nivartaka ādīnām saṃbhavaḥ karma kṛtasya bandhasya niṣkṛti nayāt karma viśeṣaḥ eva nivartakaḥ syāt nivartaka jñānam ca tatas jñānam pravartate iti smaraṇāt karma sādhyam

original: kathaṃ ca bandhakasvabhāvasya karmaṇaḥ kvacinmumukṣopayogaḥ ? antaḥkaraṇasya kutaḥ kīdṛṅmālinyam ? kutaśca kīdṛṅnairmalyam ? karmaṇaśca pramāṇatantraṃ jñānaṃ pratīva viṣayānukūlyadhīnighnāṃ vividiṣāṃ pratyapi kāraṇatvaṃ na dṛṣṭam |
analyzed: katham ca bandhaka svabhāvasya karmaṇaḥ kvacid mumukṣā upayogaḥ antaḥkaraṇasya kutas kīdṛś mālinyam kutas ca kīdṛś nairmalyam karmaṇaḥ ca pramāṇa tantram jñānam prati iva viṣaya ānukūlya dhī nighnām vividiṣām prati api kāraṇa tvam na dṛṣṭam

original: nivṛttidharmasya mokṣahetutvābhāve tadvākyavaiyarthyaprasaṅgaḥ, ityādiśaṅkāśaṅkūnuddharan kaṇṭhoktamābhiprāyikaṃ ca saṃkalayya darśayati -- etadi ti |
analyzed: nivṛtti dharmasya mokṣa hetu tva abhāve tad vākya vaiyarthya prasaṅgaḥ ityādi śaṅkā śaṅkūn uddharan kaṇṭha uktam ābhiprāyikam ca saṃkalayya darśayati etadi ti

original: prapañcitasya saṃkṣepaḥ saṃkṣiptasya prapañcanam |
analyzed: prapañcitasya saṃkṣepaḥ saṃkṣiptasya prapañcanam

original: etaduktaṃbhavatinā samādhirvyākulasya ca || 294 ||
analyzed: etat uktam bhavatinā samādhiḥ vyākulasya ca

original: ācchādakatvoktyā bhāvarūpatvaṃ sūcyate | tata eva tadupahitasyopādānatvasaṃbhavaḥ | avidyayā manāgiva channatvādbrahmaṇyadhyāsādyupapattiḥ | svapnadṛṣṭapuruṣāntarādibhedadarśanasāmyasūcanāya apāramārthika śabdaḥ | bhedadarśanameve tyatra dehātmaikyabuddhāvapi kartṛtvabhoktṛtvadevatvamanuṣyatvādibhedadarśanamantarṇīyate |
analyzed: ācchādaka tva uktyā bhāva rūpa tvam sūcyate tatas eva tad upahitasya upādāna tva saṃbhavaḥ avidyayā manāk iva channa tvāt brahmaṇi adhyāsa ādi upapattiḥ svapna dṛṣṭa puruṣa antara ādi bheda darśana sāmya sūcanāya apāramārthika śabdaḥ bheda darśanam eva iti atra deha ātma aikya buddhau api kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tva deva tva manuṣya tva ādi bheda darśanam antarṇīyate

original: tena dehātiriktatvajñānamevālaṃ, kimakartṛtvādiviśeṣitabrahmajñāneneti ca śaṅkā nirastā | karmaṇo'pi na svayaṃ bandhakatvam, dṛṣṭopanāyakasādhāraṇanimittatvāt | ato bhedabhramasiddhasya karmaṇo'pyapāramārthikatvāt bhedabhramadvāreṇaiva bandhakatvāccātra jñānetaranivartyaṃ satyaṃ kimapi na bandhakamastītyavadhāraṇābhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: tena deha atirikta tva jñānam eva alam kim akartṛ tva ādi viśeṣita brahma jñānena iti ca śaṅkā nirastā karmaṇaḥ api na svayam bandhaka tvam dṛṣṭa upanāyaka sādhāraṇa nimitta tvāt atas bheda bhrama siddhasya karmaṇaḥ upi apāramārthika tvāt bheda bhrama dvāreṇa eva bandhaka tvāt ca atra jñāna itara nivartyam satyam kim api na bandhakam asti iti avadhāraṇa abhiprāyaḥ

original: nanvasatyātsatyasiddhistvanmate'stītyatrāha -- bandhaśce ti | bandhasya abādhitatve hi satyatvāsatyatvaśaṅkā, brahmaṇo nityamuktatvavirodhaśceti bhāvaḥ | niṣkṛtinyāyaparihārāyāha -- sa ce ti | satkarmaṇā pāpanivṛttiśca bhrāntisiddhā |
analyzed: nanu asatyāt satya siddhiḥ tvad mateḥ ti iti atra āha bandhaḥ ca iti bandhasya abādhita tve hi satya tva asatya tva śaṅkā brahmaṇaḥ nitya mukta tva virodhaḥ ca iti bhāvaḥ niṣkṛti nyāya parihārāya āha sa ca iti sat karmaṇā pāpa nivṛttiḥ ca bhrānti siddhā

original: ato mūlabhūtāvidyāprabhṛtibandhaparyantaṃ kṛtsnaṃ mantranirapekṣarajjusarpanayāt karmanirapekṣādvaitabuddhyaiva bādhyamityabhiprāyeṇa jñānenaive tyuktam | mokṣasādhanasya karmasamucca yābhāve'pi smṛtivaśāttadutpādakasya syādityatrāha -- nivartakami ti | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- vigītaṃ pramāṇajanyaṃ nivartakajñānatvāt avigītavat;
analyzed: atas mūla bhūta avidyā prabhṛti bandha paryantam kṛtsnam mantra nirapekṣa rajju sarpa nayāt karma nirapekṣa advaita buddhyā eva bādhyam iti abhiprāyeṇa jñānena eva iti uktam mokṣa sādhanasya karma samucca ya abhāve pi smṛti vaśāt tad utpādakasya syāt iti atra āha nivartakam i ti ayam bhāvaḥ vigītam pramāṇa janyam nivartaka jñāna tvāt avigīta vat

original: na karmajanyamiti vā sādhyam | smṛtistvanyaparā | pariśeṣādvākyahetukatvaṃ svoktayuktibalāditi | paroktaḥ karmopayogaḥ pramāṇaśūnya ityabhiprāyeṇāha -- tasyaitasye ti | tasya -- advaitagocarasya karmavyatiriktakaraṇatadanugrāhakavataḥ | etasya -- svaviṣayaviruddhabādhe svayameva samarthasya |
analyzed: na karma janyam iti vā sādhyam smṛtiḥ tu anyaparā pariśeṣāt vākya hetuka tvam sva ukta yukti balāt iti para uktaḥ karma upayogaḥ pramāṇa śūnyaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha tasya etasya iti tasya advaita gocarasya karma vyatirikta karaṇa tad anugrāhakavataḥ etasya sva viṣaya viruddha bādhe svayam eva samarthasya

original: anvayavyatirekavataḥ kāraṇāntaravyapohāya vākyajanyatvoktiḥ | yajñena vividi ṣa ntīti śruteryajñādīnāṃ viniyogapṛthaktvena pṛthakphalatvopapattiriti ravyāpayati -- vividiṣāyāmi ti | yathāśrutāyāmityavadhāraṇābhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: anvaya vyatirekavataḥ kāraṇa antara vyapohāya vākya janya tva uktiḥ yajñena vividi santi iti śruteḥ yajña ādīnām viniyoga pṛthaktvena pṛthak phala tva upapattiḥ iti vividiṣāyām iti yathāśrutāyām iti avadhāraṇa abhiprāyaḥ

original: tatrāpyavyavahitahetutvaṃ tuśabdena vyāvartyate | asinā jighāṃsatītyādivat kliṣṭagatirbādhasiddhau | atha manomālinyādikaṃ vivṛṇoti -- sa ce ti | dharmasya pāpanivṛttyādi sādhyāntaraṃ vihitam | śraddhāyāḥ sattvarūpasādhyāntaraṃ ca śāstrasiddham | sattvasya jñānasādhanatvoktiśca paraṃparayā syāt | pāpamūlarajastamovivṛddhirmanomālinyam|
analyzed: tatra api avyavahita hetutvam tuśabdena vyāvartyate asinā jighāṃsati ityādi vat kliṣṭa gatiḥ bādha siddhau atha manomālinyādikam vivṛṇoti sa ca iti dharmasya pāpa nivṛtti ādi sādhya antaram vihitam śraddhāyāḥ sattva rūpa sādhya antaram ca śāstra siddham sattvasya jñāna sādhana tva uktiḥ ca paraṃparayā syāt pāpa mūla rajaḥ tamaḥ vivṛddhiḥ manomālinyam

original: dharmeṇa tadapanuttyā sattvaśuddhirnairmalyam |
analyzed: dharmeṇa tad apanuttyā sattva śuddhiḥ nairmalyam

original: karmabhiḥ śuddhacittasya tattve syādanukūladhīḥ |
analyzed: karmabhiḥ śuddha cittasya tattve syāt anukūla dhīḥ

original: etena śravaṇāditrikaṃ darśanasādhanatayā vidhīyata iti kaiściduktasya yuktivirodhaḥ jhrsthāṭakhyāpitaḥ |

original: nanu śrotavyo mantavyaḥ ityetābhyāmupadeśakagamyārthaśravaṇamātraṃ vidheyamastu; āhuśca kecit -- sāṃkhyayogopadeśaśravaṇādikamiti | atrāha -- tasmādi ti prāptāprāptavivekāttatsiddhādvā | pariśeṣādityarthaḥ | evakāraḥ śravaṇamananayoḥ jñānamātrasya sanpratyayavācyecchāyāśca vyavacchedārthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu śrotavyaḥ mantavyaḥ iti etābhyām upadeśaka gamya artha śravaṇa mātram vidheyam astu āhuḥ ca kecid sāṃkhya yoga upadeśa śravaṇa ādikam iti atra āha tasmāt i ti prāpta aprāpta vivekāt tad siddhāt vā pariśeṣāt iti arthaḥ eva kāraḥ śravaṇa mananayoḥ jñāna mātrasya sanpratyaya vācya icchāyāḥ ca vyavaccheda arthaḥ

original: draṣṭavya ityasyāpi dhyānaviśeṣaṇavāditayā pṛthagvidhitātparyavyudāsārtho vā | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- śrotavyo mantavya ityanayoravaidhaprasiddhopakārakatvasaṃbhave tadviparītaklṛpterayuktatvāt śrotavyaḥ ityādeśśravaṇādicatuṣṭayavidhiparatve vākyabhedāpatteḥ, atra vikalpasyāṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatayā gurulaghuviṣayatayā cātyantāsaṃbhavātkramabhāvyupakārasya

original: śravaṇādessamādhirūpāṅginā samuccayāsaṃbhavādviśiṣṭavidhergatyantarābhāvaniyatatvāt, dhyānasya darśanarūpatāyāśśrutyantarānusāreṇa sādhayiṣyamāṇatvāt, ata eva nipūrvasyāpi dhyāyateriha padāntarasphuṭopāttadarśanarūpāvaiśiṣṭyoktāvudāsīnatvāt, draṣṭavya ityasyānuvādasamabhivyāhāre'pi svarasāvagatavidhiparatvaprahāṇena
analyzed: śravaṇa ādeḥ samādhi rūpa aṅginā samuccaya asaṃbhavāt viśiṣṭa vidheḥ gati antara abhāva niyata tvāt dhyānasya darśana rūpa tāyāḥ śruti antara anusāreṇa sādhayiṣyamāṇa tvāt atas eva nipūrvasya api dhyāyateḥ iha pada antara sphuṭa upātta darśana rūpa a vaiśiṣṭya uktau udāsīna tvāt draṣṭavyaḥ iti asya anuvāda samabhivyāhāre pi svarasa avagata vidhi paratva prahāṇena

original: phalānuvādaparatvakalpanānupapatteḥ, śrotavyaḥ śrutivākyebhya ityādiśloke'pi śravaṇāditrikasya kramāddarśanahetutvamātroktau sādhyasyāpi vidheyatve virodhābhāvācca rāgaprāptaśravaṇādipūrvakaṃ vidhipadāntaropāttadarśanākāraviśeṣitadhyānamevātra vidheyamiti |
analyzed: phala anuvāda paratva kalpanā anupapatteḥ śrotavyaḥ śruti vākyebhyaḥ ityādi śloke api śravaṇa ādi trikasya kramāt darśana hetutva mātra uktau sādhyasya api vidheya tve virodha abhāvāt ca rāga prāpta śravaṇa ādi pūrvakam vidhi pada antara upātta darśana ākāra viśeṣita dhyānam eva atra vidheyam iti

original: evaṃ vedanādiśabdānāṃ svoktaviśeṣavidhiviśramānabhyupagame sūtravirodhamapi sūcayati -- vakṣyati ce ti | cintanārtho hi dhyāyatirekaviṣayamasakṛdāvṛttaṃ jñānaṃ vakti | ato dhyānaviṣaye upadiṣṭaṃ vedanaṃ dhyānameveti prakṛtasiddhiḥ | tathopāstirapi tasminyadantastadupāsitavyamityā dibhirupāttaḥ |
analyzed: evam vedanā ādi śabdānām sva ukta viśeṣa vidhi viśrama an abhyupagame sūtra virodham api sūcayati vakṣyati ca iti cintana arthaḥ hi dhyāyatireka viṣayam asakṛt āvṛttam jñānam vakti atas dhyāna viṣaye upadiṣṭam vedanam dhyānam eva iti prakṛta siddhiḥ tathā upāstiḥ api tasmin yat antaḥ tat upāsitavyam ityā dibhiḥ upāttaḥ

original: ato yajñādisāpekṣatvānuguṇam upadeśādi tyanenaiva saṃgṛhītam |

original: tadidamapavargopāyatayā vidhitsitaṃ vedanamupāsanamityavagamyate, vidyupāsyorvyatikareṇopakramopasaṃhāradarśanāt -- mano brahmetyupāsītetyatra bhāti ca tapati ca kīrtyā yaśasā brahmavarcasena ya evaṃ veda | na sa veda, akṛtsno hyeṣa ātmetyevopāsīta |
analyzed: tat idam apavarga upāya tayā vidhitsitam vedanam upāsanam iti avagamyate vidi upāsyoḥ vyatikareṇa upakrama upasaṃhāra darśanāt manaḥ brahma iti upāsīta iti atra bhāti ca tapati ca kīrtyā yaśasā brahmavarcasena yaḥ evam veda na sa veda akṛtsnaḥ hi eṣaḥ ātmā iti eva upāsīta

original: yastadveda yatsa veda sa mayaitaduktaḥ ityatra anu ma etāṃ bhagavo devatāṃ śādhi yāṃ devatāmupāssa iti | dhyānaṃ ca tailadhārāvadavicchinnasmṛtisantānarūpam, dhruvā smṛtiḥ | smṛtilambhe sarvagranthīnāṃ vipramokṣa iti dhruvāyāḥ smṛterapavargopāyatvaśravaṇāt |
analyzed: yaḥ tat veda yat sa veda sa mayā etat uktaḥ iti atra anu me etām bhagavaḥ devatām śādhi yām devatām upāsse iti dhyānam ca taila dhārā vat avicchinna smṛti santāna rūpam dhruvā smṛtiḥ smṛti lambhe sarva granthīnām vipramokṣaḥ iti dhruvāyāḥ smṛteḥ apavarga upāya tva śravaṇāt

original: vedanādisāmānyaśabdānāṃ dhruvānusmṛtirūpopāsane viśrāntiḥ |

analyzed: prāk pratijñātam upāsana ākhya viśeṣe vedanā ādi sāmānya śabdānām viśramam āha tadi ti tat tad uktau anirdhārita viśeṣam

original: idam -- gurutaradhyānādisādhyasādhanatayā vidhānādviśeṣa

original: dṛṣṭau tadekatāpattyarham | taddhetuṃ vyanakti -- apavargopāyatayā vidhitsitami ti | upāsanamityavagamyata iti | tulyaprakaraṇasthopāsisamānaviṣayavedanādiśabdanirdiṣṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ | upadeśāditi sūtritamekaprakaraṇasthaviśeṣamanyamapi hetumāha -- vidyupāsyori ti | mana ityādāvupāsirādau, vidirante | yastadityatra tu tadviparītam;
analyzed: dṛṣṭau tad ekatā āpatti arham tad hetum vyanakti apavarga upāya tayā vidhitsitam iti upāsanam iti avagamyate iti tulya prakaraṇa stha upāsi samāna viṣaya vedana ādi śabda nirdiṣṭa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ upadeśāt iti sūtritam eka prakaraṇa stha viśeṣam anyam api hetum āha manaḥ ityādau upāsiḥ ādau vidiḥ ante yaḥ tat iti atra tu tad viparītam

original: na sa vedetyatra tūbhayata upāstiḥ, atha yo'nyāṃ devatāmupāste sa yo'ta ekaikamupāsta ityupakramāt | evaṃ mithassthānākrāntiriha vyatikaraḥ | nanvatra mano brahmeti dṛṣṭividhiḥ; anyacca vākyadvayaṃ vidyāviśeṣastham |
analyzed: na sa veda iti atra tu ubhayatas upāstiḥ atha yonyām devatām upāste sa yā uta ekaikam upāste iti upakramāt evam mithas sthāna ākrāntiḥ iha vyatikaraḥ nanu atra manaḥ brahma iti dṛṣṭi vidhiḥ anyat ca vākya dvayam vidyā viśeṣa stham

original: ekatra śabdavṛttiryā sthitā sā'nyatra saṃcaret |

original: tattulye'pītyabhipretya darśanāditi bhāṣyate || 300 ||

original: ya evaṃ vedeti na śāstrārthavedanāmātroktiḥ; vihitasya ākāṅkṣitaṃ phalamanirdiśyāvihitānyānuvādena tatphalokterayukteḥ | nanu bhūmavidyopakrame sa yo mano brahmetyupāste yāvanmanaso gataṃ tatrāsya yathākāmacāro bhavatī ti phalaviśeṣa uktaḥ | tenaiva nairākāṅkṣyaṃ syāt;

original: maivam -- tṛtīyaprapāṭhakasthasyāsya upāsanaprakaraṇabhedāt, punaśśrutivaiyarthyācca, vidheyāntaratve siddhe sannihitaphalenaiva samanvayopapatteḥ | ato'sminnarthavāde vidinopāsanamanūdya tatphalavidhiryuktaḥ | rātrisatranyāyaścātrābhipretaḥ | dānādijanyā prathā kīrtiḥ | parākramādijanyā tu yaśaḥ | kīrtyā yaśasā ca bhāti;
analyzed: mā evam tṛtīya prapāṭhaka sthasya asya upāsana prakaraṇa bhedāt punar śruti vaiyarthyāt ca vidheya antara tve siddhe sannihita phalena eva samanvaya upapatteḥ atas smin arthavāde vidinā upāsanam anūdya tad phala vidhiḥ yuktaḥ rātri satra nyāyaḥ ca atra abhipretaḥ dāna ādi janyā prathā kīrtiḥ parākrama ādi janyā tu yaśaḥ kīrtyā yaśasā ca bhāti

original: brahmavarcasena tapatīti yojyam | madhyamavākye'tretyanuktirāsannatvāt | yastadityādau yastat brahma veda, yacca brahma sa veda sa veditā raikvaḥ tadvedyametat brahma ceti dvitayaṃ tavoktamityarthaḥ | gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ jagadi tyādiṣviva cakārānuktiḥ | napuṃsakasamabhivyāhārāduktamiti vipariṇamanīyam | vedyaṃ prati sa veditṛtvenokta iti vā neyam |
analyzed: brahmavarcasena tapati iti yojyam madhyama vākya itra iti anuktiḥ āsannatvāt yaḥ tat ityādau yaḥ tat brahma veda yat ca brahma sa veda sa veditā raikvaḥ tad vedyam etat brahma ca iti dvitayam tava uktam iti arthaḥ gām aśvam puruṣam jagadi tyādiṣu iva cakāra anuktiḥ napuṃsaka samabhivyāhārāt uktam iti vipariṇamanīyam vedyam prati sa veditṛ tvena uktaḥ iti vā neyam

original: atha vā yat sa raikvo veda, tadevānyo yo veda, enaṃ sarvaṃ tadabhisameti yatkiṃcitprajāssādhu kurvantīti pūrvatrānvayaḥ | sa mayaitaduktaḥ ityatra etaditi kriyāviśeṣaṇam; sa mayaivamukta ityarthaḥ | asyāṃ vyākhyāyāṃ prakaraṇānuguṇyāt raikvaśiṣyeṇa bhavitavyamiti jānaśruteḥ sūcyate | anuśādhi -- vivicya jñāpayeti yāvat |
analyzed: atha vā yat sa raikvaḥ veda tat eva anyaḥ yaḥ veda enam sarvam tat abhisameti yat kiṃcid prajāḥ sādhu kurvanti iti pūrvatra anvayaḥ sa mayā etat uktaḥ iti atra etat iti kriyāviśeṣaṇam sa mayā evam uktaḥ iti arthaḥ asyām vyākhyāyām prakaraṇa ānuguṇyāt raikva śiṣyeṇa bhavitavyam iti jānaśruteḥ sūcyate anuśādhi vivicya jñāpaya iti yāvat

original: evaṃ vedanasya prastutadhyānopāsanaśabdavācyatvamityuktam, na tu dhyānasyopāsanatvamihocyate; vedanamupāsanamityavagamyate vidyupāsyoḥ ityādibhāṣaṇāt vedanamupāsanaṃ syāt iti pradarśayiṣyamāṇavākyasaṃvādācca | dhyānopāsanaśabdayorekaviṣayatvaṃ dhyānasya pratikūladhyānādvyāvṛttiśceha arthādeva sidhyataḥ |
analyzed: evam vedanasya prastuta dhyāna upāsana śabda vācya tvam iti uktam na tu dhyānasya upāsana tvam iha ucyate vedanam upāsanam iti avagamyate vidi upāsyoḥ ityādi bhāṣaṇāt vedanam upāsanam syāt iti pradarśayiṣyamāṇa vākya saṃvādāt ca dhyāna upāsana śabdayoḥ eka viṣaya tvam dhyānasya pratikūla dhyānāt vyāvṛttiḥ ca iha arthāt eva sidhyataḥ

original: yadi dhyānamihopāsanatvena śabdato viśeṣyate; tadā dhyānasya punarākārāntaroktau śrṛṅkhalā bhajyeta |

original: nanu dhyānaśabdaḥ cintāmātravācī vyavahitasmṛtisantāne'pi syāt, smṛtimātre ca kvacitprayujyate; sūtre ca dhyānopāsanaśabdābhyāmasakṛdāvṛttimātramuktamityatra tadabhipretaṃ śrautaṃ nairantaryarūpaviśeṣamāha -- dhyānaṃ ce ti | yāvajjīvāgnihotranayādvā svarūpeṇa cirakālasthāyitayā vā dhruvatvaṃ syāditi śaṅkānirāsāya sadṛṣṭāntaḥ santānaśabdaḥ |
analyzed: nanu dhyāna śabdaḥ cintā mātra vācī vyavahita smṛti santāne api syāt smṛti mātre ca kvacid prayujyate sūtre ca dhyāna upāsana śabdābhyām asakṛt āvṛtti mātram uktam iti atra tad abhipretam śrautam nairantarya rūpa viśeṣam āha dhyānam ca iti yāvat jīva agnihotra nayāt vā sva rūpeṇa cira kāla sthāyi tayā vā dhruva tvam syāt iti śaṅkā nirāsāya sa dṛṣṭāntaḥ santāna śabdaḥ

original: evaṃ vicchinnāvicchinnavedanasādhāraṇasya dhyānasya viśeṣe viśrama uktaḥ; avicchinnāsādhāraṇyaṃ vā sthāpitam | svasthāne caitat sūtrayiṣyati -- dhyānācca, acalatvaṃ cāpekṣyeti | upāsanaśabdasyāvicchinnaviṣayatvavat dhyānaśabdasyāpyavicchinnaviṣayatvamiha sthāpyata iti tūlikā | uktaṃ śrutyopapādayati -- dhruveti |
analyzed: evam vicchinna avicchinna vedana sādhāraṇasya dhyānasya viśeṣe viśramaḥ uktaḥ avicchinna asādhāraṇyam vā sthāpitam sva sthāne ca etat sūtrayiṣyati dhyānāt ca acala tvam ca apekṣya iti upāsana śabdasya avicchinna viṣaya tva vat dhyāna śabdasya api avicchinna viṣaya tvam iha sthāpyate iti tūlikā uktam śrutyā upapādayati dhruvā iti

original: smṛterdhruvatvaṃ visadṛśabuddhivyavadhānarahitapravāhatvam, tadrūpapratyaye caikā santatiścānyanispṛhā ityādinā tathokteḥ | yadyapi nānā śabdādibhedādityatra phalasaṃyogaikyamātrānna vidyaikyamiti vakṣyate; dhyānatvopāsanatvadhruvatvādayaśca viśeṣā vidyāntarapaṭhitāḥ;
analyzed: smṛteḥ dhruva tvam visadṛśa buddhi vyavadhāna rahita pravāha tvam tad rūpa pratyaye ca ekā santatiḥ ca anya nispṛhā ityādinā tathā ukteḥ yadi api nānā śabda ādi bhedāt iti atra phala saṃyoga aikya mātrāt na vidyā aikyam iti vakṣyate dhyāna tva upāsana tva dhruva tva ādayaḥ ca viśeṣāḥ vidyā antara paṭhitāḥ

original: tathā'pi sādhāraṇānāṃ vedanādiśabdānāṃ viśeṣaviṣayatvābhāve phale ca tāratamyarahite gurulaghūpāyabhedavidhidausthyam | gurulaghuvikalpāyogalakṣaṇaṃ ca vastusāmarthyaṃ prakaraṇādbalīyaḥ, atassmṛterdhruvatvam | idamekatra śrutamapi sarvāsu vidyāsu yojyamityabhiprāyeṇa apavargopāyatvaśravaṇādi

original: vidhirhi svataḥ pravṛttyunmukhaṃ puruṣaṃ prerayan svasiddhyai prayājādiśāstreṣvivātrāpi sakṛt pravartayet; viśeṣavacane sati khalu āvṛttibhārassoḍhavya ityabhiprāyeṇoktam -- śabdārthasya kṛtatvādi ti | vidhiviṣayasya ghātvarthasya tāvataiva pūrṇonuṣṭhitatvādityarthaḥ | uttaravākyasthena tuśabdena sūcitamāha -- pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtve ti |
analyzed: vidhiḥ hi svatas pravṛtti unmukham puruṣam prerayan sva siddhyai prayāja ādi śāstreṣu iva atra api sakṛt pravartayet viśeṣa vacane sati khalu āvṛtti bhāraḥ soḍhavyaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa uktam śabda arthasya kṛta tva ādi ti vidhi viṣayasya ghātvarthasya tāvatā eva pūrṇaḥ anuṣṭhita tvāt iti arthaḥ uttara vākya sthena tuśabdena sūcitam āha pūrvapakṣam kṛtvā iti

original: tatpratikṣepokiṃta darśayati -- siddhami ti | nyāyata upāsanaṃ siddhamityarthaḥ | siddham -- siddhānta iti vā | upāsanaśabdāt | na hi sakṛdbuddhāvupāsanaśabdasya prakhyātiriti bhāvaḥ | etadvākyaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- vedanami tyādinā | upāsanaśabdādi tyanena vedanamupāsanami ti vākyasyāpi śabdapratyabhijñayā siddhāntaparatvaṃ darśitaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: darśayati siddham i ti nyāyataḥ upāsanam siddham iti arthaḥ siddham siddhāntaḥ iti vā upāsana śabdāt na hi sakṛt buddhau upāsana śabdasya prakhyātiḥ iti bhāvaḥ etat vākyam vyācaṣṭe vedanam i tyādinā upāsana śabda ādi ti anena vedanam upāsanam i ti vākyasya api śabda pratyabhijñayā siddhānta para tvam darśitam bhavati

original: dhyānasya dhruvatvaṃ sūtrānuktamapi nyāyasāmyātsūcitaṃ prāk svena vivṛtam | vākye tu dhyānādabhinnasya upāsanasyāpi taduktamupādatte -- upāsanami ti | darśanam -- svārasikī lokadṛṣṭiḥ | nirvacanam -- nirṇāyakatayā prāguktaṃ śrutivākyam | yadvā darśanam -- pratyakṣaśrutiḥ | nirvacanam -- niṣkṛṣya vacanamupabṛṃhaṇam |
analyzed: dhyānasya dhruva tvam sūtra anuktam api nyāya sāmyāt sūcitam prāk svena vivṛtam vākye tu dhyānāt abhinnasya upāsanasya api tat uktam upādatte upāsanam i ti darśanam svārasikī loka dṛṣṭiḥ nirvacanam nirṇāyaka tayā prāguktam śruti vākyam yat vā darśanam pratyakṣa śrutiḥ nirvacanam niṣkṛṣya vacanam upabṛṃhaṇam

original: tasyaiva -- muktisādhanatayā vihitasyaiva, na tu pareṣṭasya muktisādhanahetorityarthaḥ | sakṛdāvṛttāvupāseḥ prayogābhāvāt upāsanarūpasyāsakṛdāvṛttasye ti vākyasthopāsanaśabdavivakṣitatvoktiḥ |
analyzed: tasya eva mukti sādhanatayā vihitasya eva na tu para iṣṭasya mukti sādhana hetoḥ iti arthaḥ sakṛt āvṛttau upāseḥ prayoga abhāvāt upāsana rūpasya asakṛt āvṛttasya iti vākyastha upāsana śabda vivakṣita tva uktiḥ

original: nanu etatsarvaṃ prapañcitami ti pūrvoktam; tatra darśanarūpatvaṃ na dṛṣṭamityatra tasyānuktasyāpi taduktābhyāmāvṛttirūpatvadhruvatvābhyāṃ tulyanyāyatvavyaktyartham anyavidhānārthaṃ cānubhāṣate -- seyami ti | dhyānatvopāsanatvābhyāmasakṛdāvṛttā vākyāntareṇoktadhruvatvaviśiṣṭā cetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu etat sarvam prapañcitam iti pūrva uktam tatra darśana rūpatvam na dṛṣṭam iti atra tasya anuktasya api tad uktābhyām āvṛtti rūpatva dhruva tvābhyām tulya nyāyatva vyakti artham anya vidhāna artham ca anubhāṣate sā iyam iti dhyāna tva upāsana tvābhyām asakṛt āvṛttā vākya antareṇa ukta dhruva tva viśiṣṭā ca iti arthaḥ

original: pratipāditā -- darśanarūpatvamapi vākyakāreṇārthāduktamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā -- nyāyasāmyādabhipretamidamasmābhiḥ prāguktamiti | nanu yadyapyanyasyānyatvaṃ na vidhātuṃ śakyam;
analyzed: pratipāditā darśana rūpa tvam api vākyakāreṇa arthāt uktam iti bhāvaḥ yat vā nyāya sāmyāt abhipretam idam asmābhiḥ prāk uktam iti nanu yadi api anyasya anya tvam na vidhātum śakyam

original: smṛtidarśanayośca sāmagrīniyamāt viruddhajātīyayoranyatraikyamasaṃbhavi, tathā'pi saṃskāramātrajanye svapnajñāne adṛṣṭaviśeṣasahakārātsākṣātkārarūpatvamivātrāpi cakṣurjanyatvāsaṃbhave'pi
analyzed: smṛti darśanayoḥ ca sāmagrī niyamāt viruddha jātīyayoḥ anyatra aikyam asaṃbhavi tathā api saṃskāra mātra janye svapna jñāne adṛṣṭa viśeṣa sahakārāt sākṣātkāra rūpa tvam iva atra api cakṣuḥ janya tva asaṃbhave pi

original: tadavinābhūtapratyakṣatve'pi dhruvānusmṛterdhītvamātrasāmyāt darśanaśabdopacāraḥ kathaṃ na syādityatrāha -- darśanarūpate ti | pratyakṣatāpattiḥ; na tu sākṣātpratyakṣatvam, asaṃbhavāt | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- svapnadhīrapi na tāvanmukhyadarśanam, cakṣurvyāpārābhāvāt |
analyzed: tad avinābhūta pratyakṣa tve api dhruva anusmṛteḥ dhī tva mātra sāmyāt darśana śabda upacāraḥ katham na syāt iti atra āha darśana rūpatā ti pratyakṣa tā āpattiḥ na tu sākṣāt pratyakṣa tvam asaṃbhavāt ayam bhāvaḥ svapna dhīḥ api na tāvat mukhya darśanam cakṣuḥ vyāpāra abhāvāt

original: kiṃ tu tatra bāhyakaraṇavṛttinirodhe sati ananyasaṃcāriṇā manasā saṃskārapaṭimnā prāganubhūteṣu viśadasmṛtirādhīyate, tadatiriktadhīkalpane ananyathāsiddhahetvabhāvāt | tatra cakṣurādyajanye'pi tajjanyatvadhīḥ asaṃsṛṣṭe saṃsṛṣṭadhīśca doṣavaśānmānasabhrāntiḥ |
analyzed: kim tu tatra bāhya karaṇa vṛtti nirodhe sati ananya saṃcāriṇā manasā saṃskāra paṭimnā prāc anubhūteṣu viśada smṛtiḥ ādhīyate tad atirikta dhī kalpane ananyathāsiddha hetu abhāvāt tatra cakṣuḥ ādi ajanye api tad janya tva dhīḥ asaṃsṛṣṭe saṃsṛṣṭa dhīḥ ca doṣa vaśāt mānasa bhrāntiḥ

original: sandhyādhikaraṇānurodhe tu saṃskāramātrajanyatvābhāvādasaṅkīrṇaṃ darśanatvam, ato na svapnanidarśanena prastute pratyakṣatvaklṛptiśśakyā | dhītvamātreṇa darśanasāmyādupacāraśca vācyāsannatamastutyanuguṇaviśeṣasiddhau na yukta iti |
analyzed: sandhyā adhikaraṇa anurodhe tu saṃskāra mātra janya tva abhāvāt asaṅkīrṇam darśana tvam atas na svapna nidarśanena prastute pratyakṣa tva klṛptiḥ śakyā dhī tva mātreṇa darśana sāmyāt upacāraḥ ca vācya āsannatama stuti anuguṇa viśeṣa siddhau na yuktaḥ iti

original: evaṃ pratyakṣatāpannāmapavargasādhanabhūtāṃ smṛtiṃ viśinaṣṭi -- nāyamātmā pravacanena labhyo na medhayā na bahunā śrutena | yamevaiṣa vṛṇute tena labhyastasyaiṣa ātmā vivṛṇute tanūṃ svāmiti | anena kevalaśravaṇamanananididhyāsanānāmātmaprāptyanupāyatvamuktvā yamevaiṣa ātmā vṛṇute, tenaiva labhya ityuktam | priyatama eva hi varaṇīyo bhavati;
analyzed: evam pratyakṣa tā āpannām apavarga sādhana bhūtām smṛtim viśinaṣṭi na ayam ātmā pravacanena labhyaḥ na medhayā na bahunā śrutena yam eva eṣa vṛṇute tena labhyaḥ tasya eṣaḥ ātmā vivṛṇute tanūm svām iti anena kevala śravaṇa manana nididhyāsanānām ātma prāpti anupāya tvam uktvā yam eva eṣa ātmā vṛṇute tena eva labhyaḥ iti uktam priyatamaḥ eva hi varaṇīyaḥ bhavati

original: yasyāyaṃ niratiśayapriyaḥ sa evāsya priyatamo bhavati; yathā'yaṃ priyatama ātmānaṃ prāpnoti, tathā svayameva bhagavān prayatata iti bhagavataivoktam --
analyzed: yasya ayam niratiśaya priyaḥ saḥ eva asya priyatamaḥ bhavati yathā ayam priyatamaḥ ātmānam prāpnoti tathā svayam eva bhagavān prayatate iti bhagavatā eva uktam

original: teṣāṃ satatayuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prītipūrvakam |
analyzed: teṣām satata yuktānām bhajatām prīti pūrvakam

original: dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te ||
analyzed: dadāmi buddhi yogam tam yena mām upayānti te

original: iti, priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ iti ca | ataḥ sākṣātkārarūpā smṛtiḥ smaryamāṇātyarthapriyatvena svayamapyatyarthapriyā yasya, sa eva pareṇātmanā varaṇīyo bhavatīti tenaiva labhyate para ātmetyuktaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: iti priyaḥ hi jñāninā utyartham aham sa ca mama priyaḥ iti ca atas sākṣātkāra rūpā smṛtiḥ smaryamāṇā atyartha priya tvena svayam api atyartha priyā yasya saḥ eva pareṇa ātmanā varaṇīyaḥ bhavati iti tena eva labhyate paraḥ ātmā iti uktam bhavati

original: dhruvānusmṛtirūpopāsanasyaiva bhaktirūpatvam |
analyzed: dhruva anusmṛti rūpa upāsanasya eva bhakti rūpa tvam

original: nanu nāyamātmetyā dau śravaṇāditrikaṃ pratiṣidhya aparyanuyojyasvatantravaraṇamātreṇa tallābha ityuktam | tasmāt daivameva varaṃ manye pauruṣaṃ tu nirarthaka miti nyāyāduktaṃ sarvaṃ vitathamityatra sūtravākyayordhruvatvādiviśeṣitāyāḥ smṛterupāsanaśabdārthatayā'bhipretaṃ bhaktirūpatvaviśeṣaṇameva tatra vivakṣitamityāha -- evami ti |
analyzed: nanu na ayam ātmā ityā dau śravaṇa ādi trikam pratiṣidhya aparyanuyojya svatantra varaṇa mātreṇa tad lābhaḥ iti uktam tasmāt daivam eva varam manye pauruṣam tu nirarthakam iti nyāyāt uktam sarvam vitatham iti atra sūtra vākyayoḥ dhruva tva ādi viśeṣitāyāḥ smṛteḥ upāsana śabda artha tayā abhipretam bhakti rūpatva viśeṣaṇam eva tatra vivakṣitam iti āha evam iti

original: sāmānyaśabdānāṃ sūtrādyuktena viśeṣaviśramaprakāreṇetyarthaḥ | pratyakṣatāpannāmi tyetat vakṣyamāṇasya bhaktyātmakatvasya nyāyasāmyasūcanārtham | ahetukavaraṇamayuktam, tasyādimattve nirhetukatvāyogāt | anāditve mukterapyanāditvāpātāt
analyzed: sāmānya śabdānām sūtra ādi uktena viśeṣa viśrama prakāreṇa iti arthaḥ pratyakṣa tā āpannām iti etat vakṣyamāṇasya bhakti ātmaka tvasya nyāya sāmya sūcana artham ahetuka varaṇam ayuktam tasya ādimat tve nirhetuka tva ayogāt anādi tve mukteḥ api anādi tva āpātāt

original: , muktyupāyavidheśca vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt, jīvavyāpārarūpabhedaviśeṣaniṣedhaparasya vaiṣamyanairghṛṇyaniṣedhakasūtrādeḥ virodhāpatteścetyabhiprāyeṇa apavargasādhanabhūtā mityuktam | phalāntarārthopāstiparatvaśaṅkā cānena nirastā | paro hyātmā'tra labhya iṣyate | viśinaṣṭi -na tu pramāṇaprāptaṃ nivartayatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: mukti upāya vidheḥ ca vaiyarthya prasaṅgāt jīva vyāpāra rūpa bheda viśeṣa niṣedha parasya vaiṣamya nairghṛṇya niṣedhaka sūtra ādeḥ virodha āpatteḥ ca iti abhiprāyeṇa apavarga sādhana bhūtā m iti uktam phala antara artha upāsti paratva śaṅkā ca anena nirastā paraḥ hi ātmā atra labhyaḥ iṣyate viśinaṣṭi na tu pramāṇa prāptam nivartayati iti arthaḥ

original: anyathā upāyāntaravidhānavaiyarthyam ,

matvā dhīro na śocati, prajñānenainamāpnuyādi ti pūrvāparavirodhaśca syāt | nāyamātme tyādau śrutaśabdena śravaṇamupāttam | medhāśabdaśca dhyānārthaḥ syāt; medhāmanīṣe mā viśatāṃ samīcī bhūtasya bhavyasyāvaruddhyai iti śrutyanusārāt | dhīrdhāraṇāvatī medheti ca nighaṇṭuḥ | pāriśeṣyātpravacanaśabdaḥ śravaṇadhyānasahoktamananaparaḥ;
analyzed: matvā dhīraḥ na śocati prajñānena enam āpnuyāt iti pūrva apara virodhaḥ ca syāt na ayam ātmā ityādau śruta śabdena śravaṇam upāttam medhā śabdaḥ ca dhyāna arthaḥ syāt medhā manīṣe mā viśatām samīcī bhūtasya bhavyasya avaruddhyai iti śruti anusārāt dhīḥ dhāraṇāvatī medhā iti ca nighaṇṭuḥ pāriśeṣyāt pravacana śabdaḥ śravaṇa dhyāna sahoktamanana paraḥ

original: procyate'neneti karaṇavyutpatteḥ | śiṣyamananārthagurupravacanena vā mananalakṣaṇā; pravacanahetau vā tatkāryopacāraḥ | nanu svarūpaniṣedhakasya kathaṃ tadvidhāyakatvam;
analyzed: procyate inena iti karaṇa vyutpatteḥ śiṣya manana artha guru pravacanena vā manana lakṣaṇā pravacana hetau vā tad kārya upacāraḥ nanu svarūpa niṣedhakasya katham tad vidhāyaka tvam

original: yathā na pṛthivyāmagniścetavyaḥ ityatra niṣedhasya hiraṇyavaikalyaparihārārthatayā hiraṇyopahitatvavidhau tātparyam, tathā'trāpi pṛthivyā iva śravaṇāderyathārhaṃ praṇāḍyā sākṣāccāvaśyaṃbhāvitvātprītivaikalyaniṣedhamukhena triṣvapi prītiviśeṣavidhau tātparyamityabhiprāyavān kevala śabdaḥ yadvā nāntarikṣe na divītya bhāgipratiṣedhena saha paṭhitaḥ
analyzed: yathā na pṛthivyām agniḥ cetavyaḥ iti atra niṣedhasya hiraṇya vaikalya parihāra ārthatayā hiraṇya upahita tva vidhau tātparyam tathā atra api pṛthivyāḥ iva śravaṇa ādeḥ yathārham praṇāḍyā sākṣāt ca avaśyaṃbhāvi tvāt prīti vaikalya niṣedha mukhena triṣu api prīti viśeṣa vidhau tātparyam iti abhiprāyavān kevala śabdaḥ yat vā na antarikṣe na divi itya bhāgi pratiṣedhena saha paṭhitaḥ

original: na pṛthivyāmiti prāptapratiṣedhaḥ yathā kevalapṛthivyā antarikṣādivadadhikaraṇatvavyudāsena hiraṇyopadhānatvavaiśiṣṭyavidhau viśrāmyati; tathā'nupāyabhūtaśravaṇamananābhyāṃ sahopāyabhūtanididhyāsanasya pratiṣedhaḥ kevalanididhyāsanasya śravaṇādivadanupāyatvoktimukhena bhaktyātmakatvavidhau paryavasyatīti |
analyzed: na pṛthivyām iti prāpta pratiṣedhaḥ yathā kevala pṛthivyāḥ antarikṣa ādi vat adhikaraṇatva vyudāsena hiraṇya upadhānatva vaiśiṣṭya vidhau viśrāmyati tathā anupāya bhūta śravaṇa mananābhyām saha upāya bhūta nididhyāsanasya pratiṣedhaḥ kevala nididhyāsanasya śravaṇa ādi vat anupāya tva ukti mukhena bhakti ātmaka tva vidhau paryavasyati iti

original: aniyamena yatheṣṭaṃ svatantravaraṇaśaṅkāvyudāsāya yadvṛttānūktibalena niyataviṣayavaraṇavyaktyarthaṃ yameve tyupādānam; vaiṣamyādidoṣānāghrātasarvasuhṛdvaraṇasya niyataviṣayatvāyogāt | yadāgneyaḥ iti vākyasthabhavativat, vṛṇuta ityasya prayojakavyāpāravidhau tātparyaṃ lapsyamānavaraṇaprayojakavyāpāravatā bhavitavyamiti |
analyzed: aniyamena yathā iṣṭam svatantra varaṇa śaṅkā vyudāsāya yad vṛtta anūkti balena niyata viṣaya varaṇa vyakti artham yam eva iti upādānam vaiṣamya ādi doṣa an āghrāta sarva suhṛd varaṇasya niyata viṣaya tva ayogāt yat āgneyaḥ iti vākya stha bhavati vat vṛṇute iti asya prayojaka vyāpāra vidhau tātparyam lapsyamāna varaṇa prayojaka vyāpāravatā bhavitavyam iti

original: nanu hiraṇyopadhānasya pṛthivīsthatvāvaśyaṃbhāvavadetadvākyasthayadvṛttavyaṅgyavaraṇīyatāhetuguṇaviśeṣasya dhruvānusmṛtisaṃbandhaniyamādṛṣṭerna tasyāstena vaiśiṣṭyalābha ityatrāha -- priyatama iti | phalāntarārthabhaktyābhāsavyavacchedārthaṃ tamapprayogaḥ hiḥ śāstrato lokataśca parāvarapuruṣasvabhāvaprasiddhau |

original: antara śabdaḥ sanpratyayarahitatvena sphuṭārthatvādaṅgānāmaṅginiṣpādane dvārapradarśanāt karmaṇāṃ vidhyantānāṃ kaṇṭhoktavedanakaraṇakaphalabhāvanāniṣṭhatayā paramapuruṣārthaviśrāntibodhanācca prāguktavākyādviśeṣaṃ vyanakti | vidyāṃ ce tyādeḥ paravidyāṃ tadaṅgabhūtāṃ karmarūpāvidyāṃ cānuṣṭheyatvena śāstrato yo vettītyarthaḥ |

original: cakārāvatroktasamuccayārthau | tayoranuktadyotakatve tu tattaditikartavyatāviśeṣayoreva vidyāphalayornivartyayośca prāptyupāyavirodhinorgrahaṇam | ubhayaṃ sahe tyatrāṅgāṅgitayā tṛtīyādhyāye sādhayiṣyamāṇayoranuṣṭheyayorbuddhyārohaṇe sāhityamabhipretam; na tu samakālatayopādeyatve | vedyatve hi sahabhāva ucyate; na tu sahitatayā vedanam |

analyzed: na hi utpatti daśāyām virodhi nirāsa daśāyām ca vidyā karmaṇoḥ sahatva saṃbhavaḥ atra andham tamaḥ praviśanti i tyādinā tatas bhūyas iva te tamaḥ ityādinā ca pratyeka nindā paratvam cakāraḥ saha śabdaḥ ca sama samuccaya sthāpakau iti na bhramitavyam teṣām anyathā asiddha tvāt ye u vidyāyām ratāḥ iti karma anādareṇa vidyā utpatti artha utsāhavantaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: karmaniratānāṃ vidyānirapekṣakarmasvarūpaṃ tāvanniṣpadyata eva; na tu tāvanmātreṇa muktiḥ; vidyāniratānāṃ hetvabhāvādvidyaiva na saṃbhavati, kutastarāṃ muktiriti bhūyaśśabdābhiprāyaḥ | avidyāśabdasyātra karmaviṣayatvaṃ prakaraṇena sthāpayati atre ti | na tu sarvatra ;

original: avidyāyāmantare vartamānāḥ, kṣaraṃ tvavidyā, anātmanyātmabuddhirye tyādiṣu arthāntare prayogāt | iha tu ātmanyevānupaśyati, kurvanneveha karmāṇī tyādinā vidyā tadaṅgaṃ karma ca prakṛtam; tadevātrāvidyāśabdena vidyopayogajñāpanārthamanūditam | paravyākhyāyāṃ vyākhyātau saṃśayaviparyayau chettuṃ padārthavākyārthau spaṣṭayati -- avidyaye ti |
analyzed: avidyāyām antare vartamānāḥ kṣaram tu avidyā anātmani ātma buddhiḥ ye tyādiṣu artha antare prayogāt iha tu ātmani eva anupaśyati kurvan eva iha karmāṇi tyādinā vidyā tad aṅgam karma ca prakṛtam tat eva atra avidyā śabdena vidyā upayoga jñāpana artham anūditam para vyākhyāyām vyākhyātau saṃśaya viparyayau chettum padārtha vākya arthau spaṣṭayati avidyaye ti

original: pāpasyānarthahetutayā avayavaśaktyā gauṇyā vā mṛtyuśabdabodhyatvāya, yajñādervividiṣotpattivirodhinivartakatvavyudāsāya, coditajñānanivartyatayā śrutismṛtiśatasiddhaprāptivirodhivyāvṛttyai ca jñānotpattivirodhitvoktiḥ | yādavaprakāśīyanirvāho'pyetena nirastaḥ | yadyatra mṛtyutaraṇaṃ muktireva, kathaṃ vidyayā'nyatsādhyaṃ syāt |

analyzed: mṛtyu śabdasya sādhāraṇya saṃbhave api tam eva viditvā ati mṛtyum eti ityādi spaṣṭa artha bahu śruti smṛti balena vidyā nivartya prāpti virodhi viṣayatva asaṃbhavāt tatra ca nā anyaḥ panthāḥ iti sādhana antara pratiṣedhena karmaṇaḥ vimukti sādhana tvena samuccetavya tva ayogāt karmaṇaḥ śruti ādibhiḥ eva vidyā sādhana tva sthāpanāt iha upāya virodhini karmaṇi eva vṛttiḥ

original: vidyāyā iva karmaṇaḥ uttarāghavirodhitvābhāvāt prācīnagrahaṇam | tīrtve tyasya svarasārthaṃ tyaktvā prāpya sthita iti paroktaṃ kliṣṭatvādadhyāhāratvāccayuktam | yajñādisatkarmaṇāṃ vividiṣāvirodhitayā mṛtyuśabdavācyaṃ karma tīrtveti gamanikā'pi vividiṣārthaviniyogapratiṣedhātpratyuktā |

original: etaṃ setu mityādiṣu gatyabhāvāttarateḥ prāptivacanatvamityabhiprāyeṇa apohye tyuktam | vidyāśabdasya śāstrādiṣvapi prayogādiha prakṛtabrahmavedanaviṣayatvaṃ vyanakti -- jñānene ti | etadamṛtam, etadabhayam, etadbrahma, brahmavidāpnoti parami tyādiśrutyanusāreṇāha -- amṛtaṃ brahme ti |

original: tvāt | mokṣaśabdasvārasyānurodhāt avidyā karmasaṃjñetyuktabandhakakarmanivṛttivivakṣāyāṃ tu tāvanmātramevopāsanasādhyam | dhīsaṅkocahetunivṛttau setubhaṅgasrotaḥpravṛttinītyā tādṛśeśvarasaṃkalpena svataḥ prāpto dhīvikāsaḥ |

original: ataḥ vidyayā'mṛtamaśnuta ityanena pratibandhanivṛttau vidyātaḥ siddhāyāṃ svatassetsyantī brahmānubhūtirucyata iti na pūrvāparavirodhaḥ | brahmaprāpteśca paramapuruṣārthatayā kāmyamānatve'pi tatpratibandhakanivṛttyupāyasya kāmyavargātpṛthageva vyapadeśaḥ |

original: atra karaṇavibhaktyantarūpakarmajñānaśabdābhyāṃ kaṣāyapaktiḥ karmāṇi jñānaṃ tu paramā gatiḥ, kaṣāye karmabhiḥ pakve tato jñānaṃ pravartata iti spaṣṭārthopabṛṃhaṇārthaḥ sūcyate | tena ca mṛtyuśabdasyātropāyavirodhiviṣayatvaṃ vedānuvacanādīnāṃ vividiṣantītyatra prakṛtyarthenānvayaḥ samuccayavādanirāsaśca sidhyet |

original: puṇyasya pāparūpatvaṃ puṇyapāpayīrdharmāpanodyatvaṃ ca |

original: āstāṃ prakaraṇam | asminneva vākye karmaṇāṃ vidyāṅgatve sādhāraṇānāmavidyādiśabdānāmasmaduktapadārthaniyame ca nirbādhaḥ svārasyaprāpto vastusāmarthyarūpo heturlakṣya ityabhiprāyeṇāha -- mṛtyutaraṇe ti | pratīte ti hetugarbham | vidyetaradi tyetat atratyāvidyāśabdaniruktiḥ |

original: abrāhmaṇādiśabdanayāttadanyavṛttau prakaraṇasthāsannaviṣayatvaṃ yuktamityabhiprāyeṇa vihitaṃ karme tyuktam | na tvavihitaṃ karma, nāpi brahmajñānādikamiti padadvayānvitāvadhāraṇābhiprāyaḥ | etena kurvanneveha karmāṇī tyatra karmaśabdaḥ sādhāraṇo'pi ucitaviṣaye niyamitaḥ; na hi kāmyādikaṃ yāvajjīvamanuṣṭheyam |

original: uktaśruterupabṛṃhaṇena svoktau padārthavākyārthau sthirīkṛtāvityāha --

original: yathoktami ti | jñānavyapāśrayaḥ āgamotthajñāne pratiṣṭhitaḥ | brahmavidyāmadhiṣṭhāya -- vivekādijanyāṃ paravidyāṃ bhaktirūpāpannāṃ niṣpādyatvenābhisaṃdhāyetyarthaḥ | āgamotthaṃ vivekācce ti prastutaṃ jñānadvayameva hyatra spaṣṭīkṛtam | ata eva mṛtyuśabdasyātra vividiṣāviro

original: dhitvaṃ cāyuktam; tasyāḥ sādhyatvenānupādānāt | brahmavidyāmadhiṣṭhāyetyanenaiva vividiṣāniṣpatterarthasiddhatvācca | tartuṃ mṛtyu miti prayojanavacanena tīrtve tyasya prāptyarthatvaśaṅkā ca nirastā | upabṛṃhaṇīyaśrautapadasūcakāvidyāśabdoktameva ca yajñaśabdena vyañjitam | yajñān iyāja -- cakāretyarthaḥ |
analyzed: dhitvam ca ayuktam tasyāḥ sādhya tvena anupādānāt brahma vidyām adhiṣṭhāya iti anena eva vividiṣā niṣpatteḥ artha siddha tvāt ca tartum mṛtyu m iti prayojana vacanena tīrtve tyasya prāpti artha tva śaṅkā ca nirastā upabṛṃhaṇīya śrauta pada sūcaka avidyā śabda uktam eva ca yajña śabdena vyañjitam yajñān iyāja cakāra iti arthaḥ

original: jñānavirodhi ca karma puṇyapāparūpam | brahmajñānotpattivirodhitvenāniṣṭaphalatayobhayorapi pāpaśabdābhidheyatvam | asya ca jñānavirodhitvaṃ jñānotpattihetubhūtaśuddhasattvavirodhirajastamovivṛddhiddhāreṇa | pāpasya ca jñānodayavirodhitvam eṣa evāsādhu karma kārayati taṃ yamadho ninīṣatīti śrutyā'vagamyate |
analyzed: jñāna virodhi ca karma puṇya pāpa rūpam brahma jñāna utpatti virodhi tvena aniṣṭa phalatayā ubhayoḥ api pāpa śabda abhidheya tvam asya ca jñāna virodhi tvam jñāna utpatti hetu bhūta śuddha sattva virodhi rajaḥ tamaḥ vivṛddhi ddhāreṇa pāpasya ca jñāna udaya virodhi tvam eṣaḥ eva asādhu karma kārayati tam yam adhas ninīṣati iti śrutyā avagamyate

original: adhītakṛtsnavedārtharūpavicāryaikyasiddhau karmabrahmakāṇḍayoḥ pratyekamapūrṇārthatvena parasparasākāṅkṣatvāt naṣṭāśvadagdharathanyāyena saṅghaṭitamityarthaḥ |

original: bhedaśaṅkādyotanam | parihārastu ṣoḍaśalakṣaṇena iti, dvādaśādhyāyīrūpakāṇḍadvayena | atra karmadevatābrahmagocarā sā tridhodbhabhau sūtrakārataḥ | jaiminermuneḥ kāśakṛtsnato bādarāyaṇādityataḥ kramāt || iti tattvara
analyzed: bheda śaṅkā dyotanam parihāraḥ tu ṣoḍaśa lakṣaṇena iti dvādaśa adhyāyī rūpa kāṇḍa dvayena atra karma devatā brahma gocarā sā tridhā udbhabhau sūtrakārataḥ jaimineḥ muneḥ kāśakṛtsnataḥ bādarāyaṇāt ityatas kramāt iti tat tvara

original: tnākarokteśca vṛtteśca kvacidupacāreṇāvirodho grāhyaḥ | ṣoḍaśalakṣaṇeneti pratibandīmabhiprayatāvāntaraviṣayādibhedānāṃ na prabandhaikyavirodhitvamiti darśitam | jaiminīyena ityanenaivārthavirodhaśaṅkā sūtratātparyānabhijñatayeti sūcyate | sūtrayiṣyati hi śārīrakārtheṣu bahuṣu jaiminessaṃvādam |
analyzed: tnākara ukteḥ ca vṛtteḥ ca kvacid upacāreṇa avirodhaḥ grāhyaḥ ṣoḍaśa lakṣaṇena iti pratibandīm abhiprayata avāntara viṣaya ādi bhedānām na prabandha aikya virodhi tvam iti darśitam jaiminīyena iti anena evā artha virodha śaṅkā sūtra tātparya anabhijña tayā iti sūcyate sūtrayiṣyati hi śārīraka artheṣu bahuṣu jaimineḥ saṃvādam

original: vyāmohaśāntyai dharmaṃ jaiminirata eva ityādiṣu kvacidvisaṃvādoktitannirāsau | parāsarśaṃ jaiminiḥ ityādau naiṣṭhikādyāśramābhāvo jaiminyasūtrito'pi nūnaṃ sakāmānāṃ gṛhasthadharmavaimukhyanivāraṇārthaṃ kadācidukto'nūdyāpāstaḥ | anyathā tadbhūtasya tu nātadbhāvo jaiminerapi ityādau naiṣṭhikādyāśramapracyutiniṣedhasya jaiminisaṃvādoktyayogāt |
analyzed: vyāmoha śāntyai dharmam jaiminiḥ atas eva ityādiṣu kvacid visaṃvāda ukti tad nirāsau parāsarśam jaiminiḥ ityādau naiṣṭhika ādi āśrama abhāvaḥ jaimini a sūtritaḥ api nūnam sa kāmānām gṛhastha dharma vaimukhya nivāraṇa artham kadācid uktaḥ unūdya apāstaḥ anyathā tad bhūtasya tu na atadbhāvaḥ jaimineḥ api ityādau naiṣṭhika ādi āśrama pracyuti niṣedhasya jaimini saṃvāda ukti ayogāt

original: madhvādiṣvasaṃbhavādanadhikāraṃ jaiminiḥ, bhāvaṃ jaiminirvikalpāmanādityādiṣvapi na śāstraikyaviruddhānuktiḥ, svoktavyāravyābhedavatsvalpānyathoktestadavi rodhāt | saṃhitatvoktyā tu kartṛbhedābhedayoḥ yathādṛṣṭi prabandhabhedābhedānāpādakatvaṃ ravyāpitam | arthasaṅgatau satyāṃ hyanyatarābhisandherubhayābhisandhervā sandhāyakatvaṃ yuktam |
analyzed: madhu ādiṣu asaṃbhavāt anadhikāram jaiminiḥ bhāvam jaiminiḥ vikalpa āmanāt ityādiṣu api na śāstra aikya viruddha anuktiḥ sva ukta vyāravya abheda vat svalpa anyathā ukteḥ tad avi rodhāt saṃhita tva uktyā tu kartṛ bheda abhedayoḥ yathādṛṣṭi prabandha bheda abheda anāpādaka tvam artha saṅgatau satyām hi anyatara abhisandheḥ ubhaya abhisandheḥ vā sandhāyaka tvam yuktam

original: brahmasaṃvādadārḍhyena pradhānārthāvirodhataḥ |

original: kutastarhi tadbhedaprathā, sati vā bhede kathaṃ ca prabandhaikyam ityanavahitānuyoge dvitīyavṛttyabhipretaṃ vyanakti -- ata iti | sayuktikasaṃpradāyādityarthaḥ | pratipipādayiṣitatvoktyā karmakāṇḍadevatādhikaraṇāderdevatātattvaniścayarahitānāmapi karmaprāśastyādipratipādanaparatvena vigrahādinirākaraṇādau tātparyābhāvassūcyate |
analyzed: kutas tarhi tad bheda prathā sati vā bhede katham ca prabandha aikyam iti anavahita anuyoge dvitīya vṛtti abhipretam vyanakti atas iti sayuktika saṃpradāyāt iti arthaḥ pratipipādayiṣita tva uktyā karmakāṇḍa devatā adhikaraṇa ādeḥ devatā tattva niścaya rahitānām api karma prāśastya ādi pratipādana paratvena vigraha ādi nirākaraṇa ādau tātparya abhāvaḥ sūcyate

original: uktaṃ hyāgamaprāmāṇye -- yathaiva hi bhagavato jaimineḥ karmaṇaḥ phalopanyāsaḥ karmaśraddhāsaṃvardhanāyeti | vivṛtaṃ caitadvedārthasaṅgrahe -- aśrutavedāntānāṃ karmaṇyaśraddhā mā bhūditi devatādhikaraṇe'tivādāḥ kṛtā iti | ativādā anyaparoktayaḥ | tāvatā'pi bāhyoktānityasaṃyogādinimittaśrutyaprāmāṇyaśaṅkānirāsāt tata eva svābhīṣṭasiddhe- ityāśayaḥ |
analyzed: uktam hi āgama prāmāṇye yathā eva hi bhagavataḥ jaimineḥ karmaṇaḥ phala upanyāsaḥ karma śraddhā saṃvardhanāya iti vivṛtam ca etat vedārthasaṅgrahe aśruta vedāntānām karmaṇi aśraddhā mā bhūt iti devatā adhikaraṇa itivādāḥ kṛtāḥ iti ativādāḥ anya para uktayaḥ tāvatā api bāhya ukta anitya saṃyoga ādi nimitta śruti aprāmāṇya śaṅkā nirāsāt tatas eva sva abhīṣṭa siddhe iti āśayaḥ

original: api caivaṃ navamādyapāde -- phaladevatayośca, na codanāto hi tādguṇyamiti prasaktayoḥ phaladevatayormadhye devatāviṣayāṇi devatā vā prayojayedityādīni sūtrāṇi yāni, tāni vyākurmaḥ -- devatoddeśena deyaṃ dravyaṃ devatā na prayojayet; kutaḥ, kṛṣyādivat phalasādhanabhūtakriyāyā eva prayojakatvopapatteḥ |
analyzed: api ca evam navama ādi pāde phala devatayoḥ ca na codanātaḥ hi tādguṇyam iti prasaktayoḥ phala devatayoḥ madhye devatā viṣayāṇi devatāḥ vā prayojayet ityādīni sūtrāṇi yāni tāni vyākurmaḥ devatā uddeśena deyam dravyam devatāḥ na prayojayet kutas kṛṣi ādi vat phala sādhana bhūta kriyāyāḥ eva prayojaka tva upapatteḥ

original: tatrāha -- devatā vā prayojayedatithivadbhojanasya tadarthatvāditi | vāśabdaśśaṅkānivartakaḥ; haviruddeśyā devatā phalārthinaṃ svārādhane prayojayet | kutaḥ, bhojanasya tadarthatvāt; bhojanasya haviṣaḥ tatsamarpaṇasya ca tadarthatvāt taccheṣatvāt | sampradānabhūtā hi devatā pradhānatayā svārthe dravyatatsamarpaṇe prayuṅkte |
analyzed: tatra āha devatāḥ vā prayojayet atithi vat bhojanasya tad artha tvāt iti vā śabdaḥ śaṅkā nivartakaḥ haviḥ uddeśyā devatā phala arthinam svārādhane prayojayet kutas bhojanasya tad artha tvāt bhojanasya haviṣaḥ tad samarpaṇasya ca tad artha tvāt tad śeṣa tvāt sampradāna bhūtā hi devatā pradhāna tayā svārthe dravya tad samarpaṇe prayuṅkte

original: kriyāpradhānavākyeṣu nyagbhūtāpi hi devatā |

original: tattanmantrādisāmarthyādārthaprādhānyaśālinī || 211 ||

original: na ca vācyaṃ vigrahādipañcakāyogāt na prayoktī devateti; smṛtyupacārānyārthadarśanairabādhitaistatsiddheḥ | ato yathā vigrahādimānatithirārādhyaḥ svārthe svābhīṣṭamupacaraṇaṃ prayuṅkte; tathā devatāpīti | ārthapatyāñca -- aryate prāpyata ityarthaḥ vibhūtiḥ, arthyata iti vā | atastadabhāvādanārādhyā anīpsitapradatvādaprayojiketi na śaṅkanīyam;
analyzed: na ca vācyam vigraha ādi pañcaka ayogāt na prayoktī devatā iti smṛti upacāra anya artha darśanaiḥ abādhitaiḥ tad siddheḥ atas yathā vigraha ādimān atithiḥ ārādhyaḥ sva arthe sva abhīṣṭam upacaraṇam prayuṅkte tathā devatā api iti ārthapatyāt ca aryate prāpyate iti arthaḥ vibhūtiḥ arthyataḥ iti vā atas tad abhāvāt anārādhyā anīpsita prada tvāt aprayojikā iti na śaṅkanīyam

original: parā khalu devatā sarvasyeṣṭe; tanniyuktā cāparā yathādhikāraṃ tattadvibhūtīnām | tathā'pi nirapekṣā devatā na kutaścit prīyeta, na kañcana prīṇāti; ataḥ kathaṃ prayojiketyatrāha -- tataśca tena sambandhaḥ |

original: tataḥ nairapekṣye'pi naradevanītyā dayaudāryaśālinyāḥ paricaryamāṇāyāḥ praseduṣyā devatāyā eva hetoḥ paricaratāḥ svābhīṣṭaphalena sambandhaḥ smṛtyupacārādibhirevaṃ siddha iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ | rāddhāntastu- api vā śarabdapūrvatvādyajñakarma pradhānaṃ syāt | atra api vā iti sārdhāṅgīkāraṃ pakṣavyāvartanam |
analyzed: tatas nairapekṣye api naradeva nītyāḥ dayā audārya śālinyāḥ paricaryamāṇāyāḥ praseduṣyāḥ devatāyāḥ eva hetoḥ paricaratāḥ sva abhīṣṭa phalena sambandhaḥ smṛti upacāra ādibhiḥ evam siddhaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ rāddhāntaḥ tu api vā śarabda pūrva tvāt yajña karma pradhānam syāt atra api vā iti sārdha aṅgīkāram pakṣa vyāvartanam

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- saktvādīnāṃ bhūtabhāvyupayogāsaṃbhavāt, japādeśca gṛhītākṣaraviṣayatvāvaśyaṃ bhāvāt, anekasaṃskāraklṛpratau gauravāt, japādisaṃskārasādhyopayogāntarādarśanāt, phalaśravaṇāñca tatra saṃskāraparityāgaḥ; na tviha tathā syāt, tathā'pi avagatakarmatvasya nirbādhatvāditi|
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ saktu ādīnām bhūta bhāvi upayoga asaṃbhavāt japa ādeḥ ca gṛhīta akṣara viṣaya tva avaśyam bhāvāt aneka saṃskāra gauravāt japa ādi saṃskāra sādhya upayoga antara adarśanāt phala śravaṇāt ca tatra saṃskāra parityāgaḥ na tu iha tathā syāt tathā api avagata karma tvasya nirbādha tvāt iti

original: atraiva nyāyasudarśanam -- ādyādhyayanamicchāmaḥ saṃskāraṃ karmatā miteḥ| svādhyāyasyopayogitvāt phalāśravaṇato'pi ca || japāderapi saṃskārakarmateṣyeta cettadā | ādyantu sarvasvādhyāyānupayogādasaṃskṛtiḥ || sarvatra karmatābādhaḥ svādhyāyasya prasajyate | tena saṃskāra ādyaṃ syādapare tvarthakarmaṇi ||
analyzed: atra eva nyāyasudarśanam ādya adhyayanam icchāmaḥ saṃskāram karma tā miteḥ svādhyāyasya upayogi tvāt phala aśravaṇataḥ pi ca japa ādeḥ api saṃskāra karma tā iṣyeta ced tadā sarva svādhyāya anupayogāt asaṃskṛtiḥ sarvatra karma tā bādhaḥ svādhyāyasya prasajyate tena saṃskāraḥ ādyam syāt apare tu artha karmaṇi

original: ārthavādikamevātra phalaṃ syādrātrisatravat || atrānīpsitakarmatvaṃ svādhyāyasyeṣyate budhaiḥ | ādye tvīpsitakarmatvaṃ tadarthā ca kriyā matā || japāderapi saṃskārakarmatve sarvasaṃskārasaṃskāryasya svādhyāyasyārthāvabodha eva bhāvyupayogaḥ syāt | tasya ca anadhikṛtakarmabhāge humādiṣu ca vaiyarthyātsarvāṇyadhyayanānyarthakarmāṇi syuḥ;
analyzed: ārthavādikam eva atra phalam syāt rātri satra vat atra anīpsita karma tvam svādhyāyasya iṣyate budhaiḥ ādye tu īpsita karma tvam tad arthā ca kriyā matā japa ādeḥ api saṃskāra karma tve sarva saṃskāra saṃskāryasya svādhyāyasya artha avabodhaḥ eva bhāvi upayogaḥ syāt tasya ca anadhikṛta karma bhāge huma ādiṣu ca vaiyarthyāt sarvāṇi adhyayanāni artha karmāṇi syuḥ

original: tadā svādhyāyasya karmatābhaṅgaḥ syāt, tasmādādyādhyayanamekameva saṃskāraḥ iti |

analyzed: nanu atra api upayoga adarśanāt ayuktiḥ siddhā saṃskārya tvāt eva upayoga klṛptau anyonya āśrayaṇāt āhuḥ ca saṃskāra vidhiḥ ca na saṃskāryam viniyuṅkte pramāṇa antara avasita upayogasya saṃskāra paryavasāyī tu saṃskāra vidhiḥ na saṃskāryasya kāryam kalpayati iti tatra āha dharma arthe iti upayoga adarśanāt hi saktu ādau karma śruti bādhaḥ

original: svādhyāyasya tu bhāvidṛṣṭādṛṣṭavividhaprayojanadarśanātsaktvā

original: divannāsaṃskāryatvaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | atra puruṣārthacatuṣṭayasya vedavedyatvavacanaṃ sarvabhāgānuvṛttaprayojanasāmānyadarśanena kṛtsnasya mīmāṃsitavyatvaravyāpanārtham; bāhyagamoktānāṃ teṣāmaśraddheyatvārthe ca | arthakāmatadupāyānāṃ keṣāñcillokasiddhatve'pi trailokyavibhavādirūpayorarthakāmayostatsādhanānāṃ ca vedavedyatvaṃ yuktam |
analyzed: di vat na asaṃskārya tvam yuktam iti bhāvaḥ atra puruṣa artha catuṣṭayasya veda vedya tva vacanam sarva bhāga anuvṛtta prayojana sāmānya darśanena kṛtsnasya mīmāṃsitavya tva ra vyāpana artham bāhya gama uktānām teṣām aśraddheya tva arthe ca artha kāma tad upāyānām keṣāṃcid loka siddha tve pi trailokya vibhava ādi rūpayoḥ artha kāmayoḥ tad sādhanānām ca veda vedya tvam yuktam

original: laukikārthakāmayorapi kārīryādiṣūpāyeṣu śāstravyāpāraḥ siddhaḥ | dharmastu dravyādyātmanā pratyakṣo'pi dhṛtisādhanatvena śāstragrāhyaḥ | yathāhuḥ -- śreyassādhanatā hyeṣāṃ nityaṃ vedātpratīyate | tādrūpyeṇa ca dharmatvaṃ tasmānnendriyagocaraḥ || iti |
analyzed: laukika artha kāmayoḥ api kārīrya ādiṣu upāyeṣu śāstra vyāpāraḥ siddhaḥ dharmaḥ tu dravya ādi ātmanā pratyakṣaḥ api dhṛti sādhanatvena śāstra grāhyaḥ yathā āhuḥ śreyaḥ sādhanatā hi eṣām nityam vedāt pratīyate tādrūpyeṇa ca dharma tvam tasmāt na indriya gocaraḥ iti

original: mokṣaśca nāsmadādipratyakṣaḥ | ātmā kadācitsamastaviśeṣaguṇaśūnyaḥ, anityaviśeṣaguṇavattvāddhaṭavadityādīnāṃ tu vipakṣe bādhakābhāvānnānumānatvam; muktiparaśāstropajīvanena vipakṣe bādhakoktau ca anumānanaiṣphalyam | niratiśayānandabrahmānubhavātmani tu mokṣe hetupravṛtterna prasaṅgaḥ; tadviparītasādhane tvāgamabādhaḥ |
analyzed: mokṣaḥ ca na asmat ādi pratyakṣaḥ ātmā kadācid samasta viśeṣa guṇa śūnyaḥ anitya viśeṣa guṇavat tvāt dhaṭa vat ityādīnām tu vipakṣe bādhaka abhāvāt na anumāna tvam mukti para śāstra upajīvanena vipakṣe bādhaka uktau ca anumāna naiṣphalyam niratiśaya ānanda brahma anubhava ātmani tu mokṣe hetu pravṛtteḥ na prasaṅgaḥ tad viparīta sādhane tu āgama bādhaḥ

original: api ca, jīvaḥ kadācitsamastaviśeṣaguṇaśūnyo na bhavati; ātmatvādīśvaravadityapi vaktuṃ śakyam | atra arthasyeva dharmasyāpi samīhitasādhanatayā pumarthasya sato dharmaviśeṣaḥ sādhanam; ataḥ so'pi tatsādhanaśabdoktaḥ | mantrārthavādayorapi yathārhaṃ caturvargabodhakatvaṃ tadbodhakopakārakatvaṃ ca grāhyam |

original: śyeneṣu vajraprabhṛtiṣvapi nānarthacodanā |

original: svādhyāyasyānya labhyopayogatvādadhyayanasya kṛtsnasvādhyāyasaṃskāratvāyogādekadeśasaṃskārasyāśābdatvāñca | adhyetavyaḥ ityasya saṃskāravidhitvābhāve niyogārthatvapakṣa eva prāpta ityata āha -- japādinā iti | ādiśabdena dhāraṇaṃ gṛhyate | svarūpeṇāpi -- na kevalamarthajñānadvāreṇetyarthaḥ | yadvā adhyāpanamādiśabdagrāhyam |
analyzed: svādhyāyasya anya labhya upayoga tvāt adhyayanasya kṛtsna svādhyāya saṃskāra tva ayogāt eka deśa saṃskārasya aśābda tvāt ca adhyetavyaḥ iti asya saṃskāra vidhi tva abhāve niyoga artha tva pakṣaḥ eva prāptaḥ iti atas āha japa ādinā iti ādi śabdena dhāraṇam gṛhyate svarūpeṇa api na kevalam artha jñāna dvāreṇa iti arthaḥ yat vā adhyāpanam ādi śabda grāhyam

analyzed: tadā sva rūpeṇa api dhuta sva rūpa mātreṇa ca iti yāvat ṛgvedam dhārayan vipraḥ ityādi smṛteḥ ayam bhāvaḥ adhyayana gṛhīta svādhyāya sādhyam eva jñānam

original: vidhibhisupajīvyam; upabṛṃhaṇānāṃ tu na svātantryeṇa dharmādisādhanatvam; asti ca śrutiḥ | vedābhyāsena satataṃ satyena tapasaiva ca | adroheṇa ca bhūtānāṃ jātiṃ smarati paurvikīm || ityādiprasiddhama nanyasādhyaṃ japādiprayojanam | tenaivānarthakānadhikṛtācikīrṣītabhāgeṣvapi saṃskāryatvopapattiḥ |
analyzed: vidhibhiḥ upajīvyam upabṛṃhaṇānām tu na svātantryeṇa dharma ādi sādhanatvam asti ca śrutiḥ veda abhyāsena satatam satyena tapasā eva ca adroheṇa ca bhūtānām jātim smarati paurvikīm ityādi prasiddham an anya sādhyam japa ādi prayojanam tena eva anarthaka anadhikṛta ācikīrṣīta bhāgeṣu api saṃskārya tva upapattiḥ

original: japavidhiśca nirarthakoñcāraṇaviṣayo'pi svādhyāyasyārthaparatāṃ na bādhate, sarvavidhibādhena svavyāghātaprasakteriti | na ca ubhayārthatve viniktaviniyogavirodhaḥ, ekenaiva rūpeṇānekārthatvābhāvāt | tathā ca nyāyasudarśanam -- svarūpeṇa japādyarthaḥ svaśaktyā'rthāvabodhakaḥ | rūpabhedādvirodho na yathāgnerdāhabhāsayoḥ || iti |

original: tadihādhyayanasaṃskṛtādvedādanantaprayojanasaṃbhavaṃ tadvicāramantareṇānyatra śāstrābhyājhrbhāṭase kaḥ prayasyediti tātparyam |

original: evamadhyayanavidhirmantravanniyamavadakṣararāśigrahaṇamātre paryavasyati |

original: nanu evaṃ viditopayogenādhyetrā arthajñānamapi vidhiphalatayā svīkāryam; aviditopayogena tu akṣaragrahaṇamapi na phalatvena pratipattuṃ śakyam; ato'nuṣṭhānaṃ pratyavyavahitopayuktamarthajñānamapi grahaṇavadadhyayanavidherdṛṣṭaṃ phalamastviti śaṅkā prastutopasaṃhāravyājena pratikṣipati -- evam iti | vidheyasvarūpaphalādinirūpaṇaprakā reṇetyarthaḥ |

original: mantravattvaṃ niyamavattvaṃ ca anūñcāraṇasthaṃ tatphale gṛhītāvupacaritam | mantrāḥ -- kāṇḍavratādyaṅgabhūtāḥ, adhyayanadaśājapyāśca śaṃ no mitraḥ ityādyāḥ | niyamāḥ -- prāguktāḥ | mantravadityetat dṛṣṭāntoktirityeke -- yathā mantre codyamānamadhyayanamakṣaragrahaṇamātraparyavasāyīti svīkriyate, tathehāpīti |
analyzed: mantravat tvam niyamavat tvam ca tad phale gṛhītau upacaritam mantrāḥ kāṇḍavrata ādi aṅga bhūtāḥ adhyayana daśā japyāḥ ca śam naḥ mitraḥ ityādyāḥ niyamāḥ prāk uktāḥ mantra vat iti etat dṛṣṭānta uktiḥ iti eke yathā mantre codyamānam adhyayanam akṣara grahaṇa mātra paryavasāyi iti svīkriyate tathā iha api iti

original: apare tu -- yathopanayanadaśoñcaraṇīyeṣūpanītamātrasya samidādhānādimantreṣu ca, tathehāpīti veditavyamiti | humādivadityanye, viṣaharaṇādimantraviśeṣavaditi ca | mātracā paryavasānaśabdena cākṣaragrahaṇātpaścātpūrvaṃ ca vidhiviśrāntirniṣidhyate |

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- adhyayanaśabdasya na tāvadarthajñānavācakatvam, avyutpatteḥ, kiñcidadhītya brāhmaṇa ityādau ca tasyārthaparatvāsaṃbhavāñca | vidhiviṣayamadhyayanaṃ pratyavyavahitasādhyamabhivyāptamavarjanīyaṃ ca phalaṃ dṛśyate |

analyzed: tad anyasya api tad phalatva klṛptau gauravam syāt vyavahita sādhyasya api phalatva klṛptau jñāna vat tad sādhyasya anuṣṭhānasya api tad klṛpti prasaṅgaḥ uttara vidhi avyavahita apekṣita tvam api grahaṇa jñānayoḥ samam yadi ca artha jñānam karma viṣaya tayā āmnātam tadā tu avyāpini vyavahite api tasmin saṃpratyayaḥ syāt na tu etat asti

original: ato'rthadhiya upayogitayaiva svīkāryā iti |

original: nanu samanvayādhikaraṇanyāyādarthajñānasyaiva svataḥ prayojanatayā phalatvaklṛptiryuktā ;

original: mevam; niratiśayānandabrahmapratipādakabhāgamātre tadukteḥ atra tu kṛtsnādhyayanaphalavimarśāt virūpaklṛptyayogāñca | nanu bṛddhavākyāni śruṇu ityādau vākyaśravaṇavigherarthadhīparyantatvaṃ lokadṛṣṭamiti cenna, vṛkṣādivanmārgalakṣaṇabhūtasya kasyacidvākyasya śrotavyatvopadeśe tātparyāttadabhāvasyāpi dṛṣṭeḥ |
analyzed: niratiśaya ānanda brahma pratipādaka bhāga mātre tad ukteḥ atra tu kṛtsna adhyayana phala vimarśāt virūpa klṛpti ayogāt ca nanu bṛddha vākyāni śruṇu ityādau vākya śravaṇa vigheḥ artha dhī paryanta tvam loka dṛṣṭam iti ced na vṛkṣa ādi vat mārga lakṣaṇa bhūtasya kasyacid vākyasya śrotavya tva upadeśe tātparyāt tad abhāvasya api dṛṣṭeḥ
