original: yadyapyakṣayaphalatvamidaṃ vidyāṅgatvena paraṃparayā netuṃ śakyam, tathā'pyatra tadvivakṣāvirahānna tathā nīyate | evaṃ parimitaphalasomahaviṣkarmasvarūpaniścaye satyeva apāma somamityādāvamṛtatvasya ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ sthānamamṛtatvamityādismṛtyā niyamaḥ |
analyzed: yadi api akṣaya phalatvam idam vidyā aṅgatvena paraṃparayā netum śakyam tathā api atra tad vivakṣā virahāt na tathā nīyate evam parimita phala soma haviṣkarma svarūpa niścaye sati eva apāma somam ityādau amṛta tvasya ābhūtasaṃplavam sthānam amṛta tvam ityādi smṛtyā niyamaḥ

original: svargasvārājyādiphalabhedasādhakakarmasvarūpabhedasiddhau ca tatra svargaśabdoktasyālpatvasiddhiḥ | yaṃ yaṃ kratumadhīta ityādiṣu ca phalatāratamyaklṛptiḥ gurulaghukarmasvarūpaniścayādeva | utpattināśavadārādhyaprīṇanakarmasvarūpaniścayāñca tatsādhyasya tatsāyujyā derasthiratvadṛṣṭiriti |
analyzed: svarga svārājya ādi phala bheda sādhaka karma svarūpa bheda siddhau ca tatra svarga śabda uktasya alpatva siddhiḥ yam yam kratum adhīte ityādiṣu ca phala tāratamya klṛptiḥ guru laghu karma sva rūpa niścayāt eva utpatti nāśa vat ārādhya prīṇana karma sva rūpa niścayāt ca tad sādhyasya tad sāyujya ādeḥ asthira tva dṛṣṭiḥ iti

original: tadevaṃ nirastapratibandhabrahmavicārārthasya śārīrakasya vidyāsthānāntaravyāvṛttasvarūpaphalābhyāṃ mīmāṃsaikadeśatvavyaktyarthaṃ nirṇetavyaviśeṣasiddhyarthaṃ ca punaḥ
analyzed: tat evam nirasta pratibandha brahma vicāra arthasya śārīrakasya vidyā sthāna antara vyāvṛtta svarūpa phalābhyām mīmāṃsā eka deśa tva vyakti artham nirṇetavya viśeṣa siddhi artham ca punar

original: adhyayane tyādikamuktam | atrāmṛtatvaśabdena trayyantapradhānavedyaphaloktiḥ; tenārvācīnānāmānuṣaṅgikānnavattvādīnāṃ saṅgatyantaraghaṭitadṛṣṭividhyādiphalānāṃ ca vyavacchedaḥ | karmabhāgoktamamṛtatvamāpekṣikaṃ sādhitam |
analyzed: adhyayane tyādikam uktam atra amṛta tva śabdena trayī anta pradhāna vedya phala uktiḥ tena arvācīnānām ānuṣaṅgika annavat tva ādīnām saṅgati antara ghaṭita dṛṣṭi vidhi ādi phalānām ca vyavacchedaḥ karma bhāga uktam amṛta tvam āpekṣikam sādhitam

original: idaṃ tu bādhādarśanāt nirṇītāṃsasaṃvādivedāntaikadeśopaṣṭambhāñca na prācyavaditi pratyāyitaprāyamityabhiprāyeṇa anantasthiraphalāpātapratīterityuktam | na hyatra phalatvādyanumānaiḥ alpāsthiratvādiklṛptiḥ śakyā, atiprasaṅgāditi | anavacchedādiha sarvaśarīraḥ śārīraḥ, tamadhikṛtya pravṛttaṃ śāstraṃ śārīrakam |
analyzed: idam tu bādhā darśanāt nirṇīta aṃsa saṃvādi vedānta eka deśa upaṣṭambhāt ca na prācya vat iti pratyāyita prāyam iti abhiprāyeṇa ananta sthira phala āpāta pratīteḥ iti uktam na hi atra phala tva ādi anumānaiḥ alpa asthira tva ādi klṛptiḥ śakyā atiprasaṅgāt iti anavacchedāt iha sarva śarīraḥ śārīraḥ tam adhikṛtya pravṛttam śāstram śārīrakam

original: vakṣyati hi ānandamayādhikaraṇe -- sa eva nirupādhikaḥ śārīra ātmā | ata evedaṃ paraṃ brahmādhikṛtya pravṛttaṃ śāstraṃ śārīrakamityabhiyuktairabhidhīyata iti | saiva mīmāṃseti śārīkamīmāṃsā; tasyām | adhikaroti svārthabuddhyā tatrodyukto bhavati, na tu pūrvavṛttāntarādadhikarotītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: vakṣyati hi ānanda maya adhikaraṇe saḥ eva nirupādhikaḥ śārīraḥ ātmā atas eva idam param brahma adhikṛtya pravṛttam śāstram śārīrakam iti abhiyuktaiḥ abhidhīyate iti sā eva mīmāṃsā iti śārīkamīmāṃsā tasyām adhikaroti svārtha buddhyā tatra udyuktaḥ bhavati na tu pūrva vṛtta antarāt adhikaroti iti arthaḥ

original: brahmavicārānantarye yuktisiddhe tadviṣayaśāstrānantaryamapi sidhyediti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: brahma vicāra ānantarye yukti siddhe tad viṣaya śāstra ānantaryam api sidhyet iti bhāvaḥ

original: grahaṇaṃ ca phalatvaṃ ca sārthatā ca svataḥ śruteḥ |
analyzed: grahaṇam ca phala tvam ca sārtha tā ca svatas śruteḥ

original: rāgātkṛtsnavicāraścetyapūrvamiha bhāṣitam || 284 ||
analyzed: rāgāt kṛtsna vicāraḥ ca itya pūrvam iha bhāṣitam

original: tathā ca vedāntavākyāni kevalakarmaphalasya kṣayitvaṃ brahmajñānasya cākṣayaphalatvaṃ darśayanti | tadyatheha karmācito lokaḥ kṣīyate, evamevāmutra puṇyacito lokaḥ kṣīyate | antavadevāsya tadbhavati | na hyadhruvaiḥ prāpyate | plavā hyete adṛḍhā yajñarūpāḥ parīkṣya lokān karmacitān brāhmaṇo nirvedamāyānnāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtena |
analyzed: tathā ca vedānta vākyāni kevala karma phalasya kṣayi tvam brahma jñānasya ca akṣaya phalatvam darśayanti tat yathā iha karma ācitaḥ lokaḥ kṣīyate evam eva amutra puṇya citaḥ lokaḥ kṣīyate antavat eva asya tat bhavati na hi adhruvaiḥ prāpyate plavāḥ hi ete adṛḍhāḥ yajña rūpāḥ parīkṣya lokān karma citān brāhmaṇaḥ nirvedam āyāt na asti akṛtaḥ kṛtena

original: tadvijñānārthaṃ sa gurumevābhigacchet samitpāṇiśśrotriyaṃ brahmaniṣṭham | tasmai sa vidvānupasannāya samyak praśāntacittāya śamānvitāya | yenākṣaraṃ puruṣaṃ veda satyaṃ provāca tāṃ tattvato brahmavidyām |
analyzed: tad vijñāna artham sa gurum eva abhigacchet samidh pāṇiḥ śrotriyam brahma niṣṭham tasmai sa vidvān upasannāya samyak praśānta cittāya śama anvitāya yena akṣaram puruṣam veda satyam provāca tām tattvataḥ brahma vidyām

original: brahmavidāpnoti param, na punarmṛtyave tadekaṃ paśyati na paśyo mṛtyuṃ paśyati, sa svarāṅ bhavati, tamevaṃ vidvānamṛta iha bhavati, nānyaḥ panthā ayanāya vidyate, pṛthagātmānaṃ
analyzed: brahma vidā āpnoti param na punarmṛtyave tat ekam paśyati na paśyaḥ mṛtyum paśyati sa svarāj bhavati tam evam vidvān amṛtaḥ iha bhavati na anyaḥ panthāḥ ayanāya vidyate pṛthak ātmānam

original: preritāraṃ ca matvā juṣṭastatastenāmṛtatvameti ityādīni |
analyzed: preritāram ca matvā juṣṭaḥ tatas tena amṛta tvam eti ityādīni

original: nanu karmaphalālpatvādau liṅgamātraṃ dṛṣṭam; yathāśrutaviruddhapratyayadārḍhyāya prāptirapi vaktavyā, karmasvarupanirūpaṇaṃ cātra svayaṃpravṛtteḥ pratibandhaśāntartham; hetustvanantasthiraphalāpātapratītireva, sā kutastyetrāha -- tathā iti | uktaprakāreṇāsya sūtrasyāpyaidamarthyaṃ yathā syāttathetyarthaḥ | caḥ avadhāraṇe |
analyzed: nanu karma phala alpatva ādau liṅga mātram dṛṣṭam yathāśruta viruddha pratyaya dārḍhyāya prāptiḥ api vaktavyā karma svarupa nirūpaṇam ca atra svayaṃpravṛtteḥ pratibandha śānta artham hetuḥ tu ananta sthira phala āpāta pratītiḥ eva sā kutastya itra āha tathā iti ukta prakāreṇa asya sūtrasya api aidamarthyam yathā syāt tathā iti arthaḥ caḥ avadhāraṇe

original: atra kṣatitvoktirakṣayitvoktiścālpatvāderupalakṣikā | niścitasaṃvādenāniścite'rthāntare'pi śraddhāsaṃvṛddhyai pūrvaṃ tadyathetyādivākyodāhṛtiḥ | loko lokyaḥ, bhogyaḥ | deśaparatve tvihāmutretyābhyāmananvayaḥ | karmacitaḥ laukikakarmalabdhaḥ |
analyzed: atra kṣati tva uktiḥ akṣayi tva uktiḥ ca alpatva ādeḥ upalakṣikā niścita saṃvādena aniścita irtha antare pi śraddhā saṃvṛddhyai pūrvam tat yathā ityādi vākya udāhṛtiḥ lokaḥ lokyaḥ bhogyaḥ deśa paratve tu iha amutra ityābhyām ananvayaḥ karma citaḥ laukika karma labdhaḥ

original: puṇyacita ityaviśeṣoktyā nivṛttidharmasādhyasyāpi kṣayitvabhramaṃ nivārayitumāha -- antavat iti | upāttavākyai kārthyāt kriyāsvarūpāntavattvasyānapekṣitavacanatvāñca phaladvārā'trāntattvoktiḥ |
analyzed: puṇya citaḥ iti aviśeṣa uktyā nivṛtti dharma sādhyasya api kṣayi tva bhramam nivārayitum āha antavat iti upātta vākyaiḥ kārthyāt kriyā svarūpa antavat tvasya anapekṣita vacana tvāt ca phala dvārā atra anta tva uktiḥ

original: yo vā etadakṣaraṃ gārgyaviditvā'smin loke juhoti yajate tapastapyate bahūni varṣasahasrāṇīti pūrvavākyāt yo vā etadakṣaraṃ gārgyaviditvā'smāllokātpraiti sa kṛpaṇa ityuttaravākyāñca; antavadityasya brahmavedanarahitakarmaviṣayatvasiddhau puṇyacitaḥ ityatrottareṣu ca tadviṣayatvaṃ sugamam |
analyzed: yaḥ vai etat akṣaram gārgi a viditvā asmin loke juhoti yajate tapaḥ tapyate bahūni varṣa sahasrāṇi iti pūrva vākyāt yaḥ vai etat akṣaram gārgi a viditvā asmāt lokāt praiti sa kṛpaṇaḥ iti uttara vākyāt ca antavat iti asya brahma vedana rahita karma viṣaya tva siddhau puṇya citaḥ iti atra uttareṣu ca tad viṣaya tvam sugamam

original: jñānarahitakarmasu svargasvārājyādiphalabhedavat keṣucinnityaphalabhedasaṃbhavāt sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo jyotiṣṭoma iti śravaṇāñcatropāttaṃ vākyaṃ prāyikaviṣayaṃ syādityātrāha -- na hīti | adhruvaiḥ adhruvaphalasādhanatayā coditairityarthaḥ | dhruvaṃ taditi vākyakhaṇḍānvayāt nityaphalārthatvābhāvaḥ ravyāpyate |
analyzed: jñāna rahita karmasu svarga svārājya ādi phala bheda vat keṣucid nitya phala bheda saṃbhavāt sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyaḥ jyotiṣṭomaḥ iti śravaṇāt catra upāttam vākyam prāyika viṣayam syāt iti ātra āha na hi iti adhruvaiḥ adhruva phala sādhanatayā coditaiḥ iti arthaḥ dhruvam tat iti vākya khaṇḍa anvayāt nitya phala artha tva abhāvaḥ

original: punarāvṛttiniyamavataḥ sarvakarmanirmūlanatvāyogena dhruvaphalasādhanatvābhāvaṃ draḍhati -- plavā iti | adṛḍhāḥ tamasaḥ pāraṃ gamayitumakṣamāḥ | aṣṭādaśoktamavaraṃ yeṣu karma | etacchreyo ye'bhinandanti mūḍhāḥ jarāmṛtyū te punarevāpi yanti | iti hyatra vākyadeṣaḥ |
analyzed: punarāvṛtti niyamavataḥ sarva karma nirmūlana tva ayogena dhruva phala sādhana tva abhāvam draḍhati plavāḥ iti adṛḍhāḥ tamasaḥ pāram gamayitum akṣamāḥ aṣṭādaśa uktam avaram yeṣu karma etat śreyaḥ mūḍhāḥ jarā mṛtyū te punar eva api yanti iti hi atra vākya deṣaḥ

original: atha sūtrārthānuguṇaṃ karmaṇāṃ nityaphalasādhanatvābhāvaniścayasya nirvedahetutvaṃ brahmajñānasyānantaphalatvaṃ ca samuñcitya vadadvākyamāha -- parī kṣyeti |
analyzed: atha sūtra artha anuguṇam karmaṇām nitya phala sādhanatva abhāva niścayasya nirveda hetutvam brahma jñānasya ananta phalatvam ca samuñcitya vadat vākyam āha parī kṣya iti

original: iyaṃ śrutiḥ sāre vyāravyātā -- brāhmaṇaḥ -- vedābhyāsarataḥ, karmacitān -- karmaṇā saṃpāditān, lokān ārādhyakṣayitvena kṣayasvabhāvān, karmamīmāṃsayā parīkṣya, akṛtaḥ -- nityaḥ paramapuruṣaḥ, kṛtena -- karmaṇā nāsti na saṃpadyata iti yo nirvedamāyāt, sa tadvijñānārthaṃ gurumevābhigacchet samitpāṇiḥ śrotriyaṃ -- vedāntavedinam, brahmaniṣṭhaṃ
analyzed: iyam śrutiḥ sāre brāhmaṇaḥ veda abhyāsa rataḥ karma citān karmaṇā saṃpāditān lokān ārādhya kṣayi tvena kṣaya svabhāvān karma mīmāṃsayā parīkṣya akṛtaḥ nityaḥ paramapuruṣaḥ kṛtena karmaṇā na asti na saṃpadyate iti yaḥ nirvedam āyāt sa tad vijñāna artham gurum eva abhigacchet samidh pāṇiḥ śrotriyam vedānta vedinam brahma niṣṭham anupraviṣṭam anupraviṣṭam anupraviṣṭam anupraviṣṭam anupraviṣṭam anupraviṣṭam anupravi

original: sākṣātkṛtaparamapuruṣasvarūpam | sa ca guruḥ samyagupasannāya tasmai, yena vidyāvi śeṣeṇa tama kṣaraṃ satyaṃ paramapuruṣaṃ vidyāt, tāṃ brahmavidyām provāca prabrūyādityarthaḥ | sa gurumevābhigacchet tasmai sa vidvān provācetyananvayāt, aprāptatvāñca | vidhāvapi liṭo vidhānāt; chandasi luṅlaṅliṭa iti, iti |
analyzed: sākṣātkṛta paramapuruṣa svarūpam sa ca guruḥ samyak upasannāya tasmai yena śeṣeṇa akṣaram satyam paramapuruṣam vidyāt tām brahma vidyām provāca prabrūyāt iti arthaḥ sa gurum eva abhigacchet tasmai sa vidvān provāca iti ananvayāt aprāpta tvāt ca vidhau api liṭaḥ vidhānāt chandasi luṅ laṅ liṭaḥ iti iti

original: atra nyāyasiddhānuvādāṃśe jātivācino'pi brāhmaṇaśabdasya prakṛtakarmaparīkṣaṇaupayikasāṅgādhyetṛsamarpaṇenājahallakṣaṇayā traivarṇikaviṣayatvārthaṃ vedābhyāsarataḥ ityuktam | brahma aṇatītyapi brāhmaṇaśabdaṃ nirbruvanti | ārādhyakṣayitveneti sukṛtavināsopalakṣaṇam | karmamīmāṃsayetyarthalabhyoktiḥ |
analyzed: atra nyāyasiddha anuvāda aṃśe jāti vācinaḥ api brāhmaṇa śabdasya prakṛta karma parīkṣaṇa aupayika sāṅga adhyetṛ samarpaṇena ajahat lakṣaṇayā traivarṇika viṣaya tva artham veda abhyāsa rataḥ iti uktam brahma aṇati iti api brāhmaṇa śabdam nirbruvanti ārādhya kṣayi tvena iti sukṛta vināsa upalakṣaṇam karma mīmāṃsayā iti artha labhya uktiḥ

original: akṛtaśabdasya puṃliṅgatānurodhāt vākyaśeṣaśaktyā ca paramapuruṣo viśeṣyo darśitaḥ | atra nāstiśabdenākṛtasya svarūpaniṣedhāyogāt karmaṇā ityanena cānanvayāt utpattiniṣedhasyānapekṣitatvāt tasya viśadabodhāyetyarthaḥ | samitpāṇitvamiha brahma
analyzed: akṛta śabdasya puṃliṅga tā anurodhāt vākyaśeṣa śaktyā ca paramapuruṣaḥ viśeṣyaḥ darśitaḥ atra nāsti śabdena akṛtasya svarūpa niṣedha ayogāt karmaṇā iti anena ca ananvayāt utpatti niṣedhasya anapekṣita tvāt tasya viśada bodhāya iti arthaḥ samidh pāṇi tvam iha brahma

original: vidyāśravaṇārthopanayanāntaravyañjanārthamiti kecit | uktaṃ hi chāndogye jābālaṃ prati gautamena -- naitadabrāhmaṇo vivaktumarhati samidhaṃ somyāharopa tvāneṣya iti | anyetvāhuḥ -- anupanīte jābāle yuktamupanayanam; anyatra tu samitpāṇitvoktirariktapāṇitvopalakṣaṇārthā;
analyzed: vidyā śravaṇa artha upanayana antara vyañjana artham iti kecid uktam hi chāndogye jābālam prati gautamena na etat abrāhmaṇaḥ vivaktum arhati samidham somya āhara upa tvā aneṣye iti anye tu āhuḥ anupanīte jābāle yuktam upanayanam anyatra tu samidh pāṇi tva uktiḥ arikta pāṇi tva upalakṣaṇa arthā

original: dṛśyate hi vaiśvānaravidyāyām -- te ha samitpāṇayaḥ pūrvāhṇe ca praticakramire tān hānupanīyaivaitaduvāca iti | prajāpativākye ca ekasyaivendrasya bahuṣu praśneṣu samitpāṇiḥ punareyāyetyāvartyate | na hi tatra bahuvāramupanayanaṃ dṛṣṭamiṣṭaṃ vā | sūtrakāraśca saṃskāraparāmarśādityetāvanmātraṃ vakṣyatīti |
analyzed: dṛśyate hi vaiśvānara vidyāyām te ha samidh pāṇayaḥ pūrvāhṇe ca praticakramire tān ha an upanīya eva etat uvāca iti prajāpati vākye ca ekasya eva indrasya bahuṣu praśneṣu samidh pāṇiḥ punar eyāya iti āvartyate na hi tatra bahu vāram upanayanam dṛṣṭam iṣṭam vā sūtrakāraḥ ca saṃskāra parāmarśāt iti etāvat mātram vakṣyati iti

original: ekāṃ śākhāmadhītya śrotriya ityuktasyādhītasvādhyāyamātrasya prakṛtānupakārakatayā vedāntavedinamiti śrotriyaśabdasyātrākāmahataśrotriyaparatvaṃ darśitam | sphuṭapravacanakṣamatvamadṛṣṭata upakārakatamatvaṃ ca brahmaniṣṭhaśabdābhipretamityāha -- sākṣātkṛtaparamapuruṣasvarūpamiti |
analyzed: ekām śākhām adhītya śrotriyaḥ iti uktasya adhīta svādhyāya mātrasya prakṛta an upakāraka tayā vedānta vedinam iti śrotriya śabdasya atra a kāma hata śrotriya paratvam darśitam sphuṭa pravacana kṣamatvam adṛṣṭataḥ upakārakatamatvam ca brahma niṣṭha śabda abhipretam iti āha sākṣātkṛta paramapuruṣa svarūpam iti

original: praśāntacittāyetyuktatvācchamo'tra bāhyakaraṇavyāpārāntaranivṛttiḥ | śamadamāviha śravaṇaupayikāvadhānārthau | tasmādevaṃvicchānto dānta ityādau tu śravaṇato viditārthasya vidyārthau | yenetyatra liṅgavyatyayasya kliṣṭatvātsāmānyopakramatvaṃ dyotayati -- vidyāviśeṣaṇeti |
analyzed: praśānta cittāya iti ukta tvāt śamaḥ utra bāhya karaṇa vyāpāra antara nivṛttiḥ śama damau iha śravaṇa aupayika avadhāna arthau tasmāt evaṃvid śāntaḥ dāntaḥ ityādau tu śravaṇataḥ vidita arthasya vidyā arthau yena iti atra liṅga vyatyayasya kliṣṭa tvāt sāmānya upakrama tvam dyotayati vidyā viśeṣaṇa iti

original: tathā ca prayuñjate tatra bādhakamabhavat kṣaṇabhaṅgo vā bāhyārthabhaṅgo vā ityādi | svarūpataḥ svabhāvataśca vikāraṃ nivartayadbhyāmakṣarasatyapadābhyāṃ pradhānakṣetrajñavyavaccheda ityabhiprāyeṇāha -- paramapuruṣamiti | saṃśayaviparyayārhavacanam, apūrṇavacanaṃ ca kṣeptuṃ tattvataḥ iti viśeṣaṇam;
analyzed: tathā ca prayuñjate tatra bādhakam abhavat kṣaṇa bhaṅgaḥ vā bāhya artha bhaṅgaḥ vā ityādi svarūpataḥ svabhāvataḥ ca vikāram nivartayadbhyām akṣara satya padābhyām pradhāna kṣetrajña vyavacchedaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha paramapuruṣam iti saṃśaya viparyaya arha vacanam apūrṇa vacanam ca kṣeptum tattvataḥ iti viśeṣaṇam

original: ācāryo'pyanācāryo bhavati śrutātpariharamāṇa iti smaranti | vṛttārthakathanabhrabhanirāsāyāha -- prabrūyāditi | abhigacchedityupakramapratītavidhibādhena vyatyayānusaraṇaṃ kliṣṭam; ataḥ provācetyasya bhūtaparatvenānanvaya ityabhiprāyeṇāha -- sa gurumeveti | niyamavidhitvamavadhāraṇena vyañjitam | provācetyasya
analyzed: ācāryaḥ upi anācāryaḥ bhavati śrutāt pariharamāṇaḥ iti smaranti vṛtta artha kathana bhrabha nirāsāya āha prabrūyāt iti abhigacchet iti upakrama pratīta vidhi bādhena vyatyaya anusaraṇam kliṣṭam atas provāca ityasya bhūta paratvena ananvayaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha sa gurum eva iti niyama vidhi tvam avadhāraṇena vyañjitam provāca ityasya

original: vidhiparatve hetvantaramāha -- aprāptatvāditi | yadyapi lābhādyapekṣayā kasyacidrāgataḥ pravṛttiḥ; tathā'pi tannirapekṣasya guroḥ sacchiṣyaviṣaye dharmārthamidaṃ vidhīyata iti na virodhaḥ | liṭo liṅarthatvasya viśeṣato'nuśiṣṭatva mapyāha -- vidhāvapīti |
analyzed: vidhi paratve hetu antaram āha aprāptatvāt iti yadi api lābha ādi apekṣayā kasyacid rāgataḥ pravṛttiḥ tathā api tad nirapekṣasya guroḥ sat śiṣya viṣaye dharma artham idam vidhīyate iti na virodhaḥ liṭaḥ liṅ artha tvasya viśeṣataḥ nuśiṣṭa tvam api āha vidhau api iti

original: brahmajñānasya paraśabdanirdiṣṭabrahmaprāpakatayā prākaraṇikanityaniratiśayānandaprāpakatvamabhipretyāha -- brahmavidi ti | brahma prāptasyāpi svargādinyāyāt imān lokānityādibhiśca punarāvṛttyādiśaṅkāṃ parihartumāha -- na puna riti | mṛtyuriha maraṇam, moho mṛtyussaṃmato yaḥ kavīnāmityādyuktaṃ vā |
analyzed: brahma jñānasya para śabda nirdiṣṭa brahma prāpaka tayā prākaraṇika nitya niratiśaya ānanda prāpaka tvam abhipretya āha brahma vidi ti brahma prāptasya api svarga ādi nyāyāt imān lokān iti ādibhiḥ ca punarāvṛtti ādi śaṅkām parihartum āha na punar iti mṛtyuḥ iha maraṇam mohaḥ mṛtyuḥ saṃmataḥ yaḥ kavīnām ityādi uktam vā

original: pāpmanāṃ niśśeṣakṣaye mṛtyūpalakṣitaṃ sarvamaniṣṭaṃ na syāt, lokānusaraṇaṃ caicchamiti bhāvaḥ | tadekadarśanamihopāyaḥ, phalaṃ vā | na pretya saṃjñāstīti yidyāprakaraṇa
analyzed: pāpmanām niśśeṣa kṣaye mṛtyu upalakṣitam sarvam aniṣṭam na syāt loka anusaraṇam ca aiccham iti bhāvaḥ tad eka darśanam iha upāyaḥ phalam vā na pretya saṃjñā asti iti

original: sthavākyena muktasya jñānalopaśaṅkāṃ nivartayan mṛtyutatkāryanivṛtiṃta ca vyanakti -- na paśya iti | muktasya tadātanaparaduḥkhaprāktanasvaduḥkhadarśane'pi tayoḥ svāśritatvavartamānatvābhāvānna taṃ prati pratikūlatvam | evaṃ hi bandhadaśāyāmapi dṛṣṭam | tatra tu paraduḥkhaduḥkhitvaṃ, gatānuśocanaṃ ca karmopādhikameva;
analyzed: stha vākyena muktasya jñāna lopa śaṅkām nivartayan ca vyanakti na paśye iti muktasya tadātana para duḥkha prāktana sva duḥkha darśane api tayoḥ sva āśrita tva vartamāna tva abhāvāt na tam prati pratikūla tvam evam hi bandha daśāyām api dṛṣṭam tatra tu para duḥkha duḥkhi tvam gatānuśocanam ca karma upādhikam eva

original: na rogaṃ nota duḥkhatāṃ sarvaṃ ha paśyaḥ paśyatītyādinā viśeṣeṇa dṛśyamāneṣvapi svaprātikūlyadarśanaṃ nāstīti hi sthāpyate | paśyo'tra tadekaṃ paśyatīti samānaprakaraṇāt brahmadarśī jīvaḥ | paśyatīti vyutpattyā paramātmanyapi, paśyaḥ paśyati paśyantamityādiprayogadṛṣṭeḥ | brahmātmakatayā sarvasya darśanāttadekadarśanasarvadarśanayoḥ na virodhaḥ |
analyzed: na rogam na uta duḥkhatām sarvam ha paśyaḥ paśyati ityādinā viśeṣeṇa dṛśyamāneṣu api sva prātikūlya darśanam na asti iti hi sthāpyate paśyaḥ utra tat ekam paśyati iti samāna prakaraṇāt brahma darśī jīvaḥ paśyati iti vyutpattyā paramātmani api paśyaḥ paśyati paśyantam ityādi prayoga dṛṣṭeḥ brahma ātmaka tayā sarvasya darśanāt tad eka darśana sarva darśanayoḥ na virodhaḥ

original: na kevalaṃ nirvyāpārasārvajñyamātram, anyarājānaste kṣayyalokā bhavantītyāmnātakarmamūlānīśvarapāratantryanivṛttyā svacchandavṛttiśca syādityabhipretyāha -- sa svarāḍi ti | ata eveśvarapāratantryasthitāvapi svarāṭ svatantra iti naighaṇṭukoktirna virudhyate |
analyzed: na kevalam nirvyāpāra sārvajñya mātram anya rājānaḥ te kṣayya lokāḥ bhavanti iti āmnāta karma mūla anīśvara pāratantrya nivṛttyā svacchanda vṛttiḥ ca syāt iti abhipretya āha sa svarāj i ti atas eva īśvara pāratantrya sthitau api svarāj svatantraḥ iti naighaṇṭuka uktiḥ na virudhyate

original: amṛtatvamyopāyāntaraniṣedhaśrutyā karmasādhyāmṛtatvokteranyaparatvaṃ draḍhayati -- tamevami ti | atra ca guṇavibhūtiviśiṣṭamahāpuruṣaparāmarśājjīvasyaiva nirviśeṣasvarūpadhiyā puruṣāntaradhiyā vā muktiḥ syāditi pareṣṭaṃ nirastam | aikyabhedābhedabuddhyoramṛtatvahetutvaṃ śrutyaiva kṣiptamityāha -- pṛthagi ti |
analyzed: amṛta tva mya upāya antara niṣedha śrutyā karma sādhya amṛta tva ukteḥ anya paratvam draḍhayati tam evam iti atra ca guṇa vibhūti viśiṣṭa mahāpuruṣa parāmarśāt jīvasya eva nirviśeṣa svarūpa dhiyā puruṣa antara dhiyā vā muktiḥ syāt iti para iṣṭam nirastam aikya bheda abheda buddhyoḥ amṛta tva hetutvam śrutyā eva kṣiptam iti āha pṛthak iti

original: tataḥ upāsanarūpāt pṛthaktvamananādityarthaḥ | tena juṣṭaḥ -- prerakeṇa prītiviṣayīkṛtaḥ | anena sthirasya parānugrahasyaiva phaladvāratoktiḥ | dhātuḥ prasādāditi ca śrūyate | nanvatrātmānaṃ preritāraṃ ceti samuccityamananamuktam; ato'nyajñānasyāpi mokṣahetutvaṃ bhāti; satyam, na tāvatā prerakaprādhānyamapahniyate |
analyzed: tatas upāsana rūpāt pṛthaktva mananāt iti arthaḥ tena juṣṭaḥ prerakeṇa prīti viṣayīkṛtaḥ anena sthirasya para anugrahasya eva phala dvāra tā uktiḥ dhātuḥ prasādāt iti ca śrūyate nanu atra ātmānam preritāram ca iti samuccitya mananam uktam atonya jñānasya api mokṣa hetu tvam bhāti satyam na tāvatā preraka prādhānyam apahniyate

original: kaściddhīraḥ pratyagātmānamaikṣat āvṛttacakṣuramṛtatvamicchannityādāvapi paravidyāṅgajīvadarśanaparam | ādiśabdaḥ bhūyasāṃ syādbalīyastvamiti nyāyena vākyāntarairapyuktadṛḍhīkaraṇārthaḥ |
analyzed: kaścid dhīraḥ pratyagātmānam aikṣat āvṛtta cakṣuḥ amṛta tvam icchan ityādau api para vidyā aṅga jīva darśana param ādi śabdaḥ bhūyasām syāt balīyaḥ tvam iti nyāyena vākya antaraiḥ api ukta dṛḍhīkaraṇa arthaḥ

original: nanu ca sāṅgavedādhyayanādeva karmaṇāṃ svargādiphalatvaṃ svargādīnāṃ ca kṣayitvaṃ brahmopāsanasyāmṛtatvaphalatvaṃ ca jñāyata eva | anantaraṃ mumukṣuḥ brahmajijñāsāyāmeva pravartatām | kimarthā dharmavicārāpekṣā | evaṃ tarhi śārīrakamīmāṃsāyāmapi na pravartatām, sāṅgādhyayanādeva kṛtsnasya jñātatvāt | satyam;
analyzed: nanu ca sa aṅga veda adhyayanāt eva karmaṇām svarga ādi phalatvam svarga ādīnām ca kṣayi tvam brahma upāsanasya amṛta tva phalatvam ca jñāyate eva anantaram mumukṣuḥ brahma jijñāsāyām eva pravartatām kimarthā dharma vicāra apekṣā evam tarhi śārīraka mīmāṃsāyām api na pravartatām sa aṅga adhyayanāt eva kṛtsnasya jñāta tvāt satyam

original: āpātapratītirvidyata eva, tathā'pi nyāyānugṛhītasya vākyasyārthaniścāyakatvādāpātapratīto'pyarthaḥ saṃśayaviparyayau nātivartate; atastannirṇayāya vedāntavākyavicāraḥ kartavya iti cet, tathaiva dharmavicāro'pi kartavya iti paśyatu bhavān |
analyzed: āpāta pratītiḥ vidyate eva tathā api nyāya anugṛhītasya vākyasya artha niścāyaka tvāt āpāta pratītaḥ api arthaḥ saṃśaya viparyayau na ativartate atas tad nirṇayāya vedānta vākya vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti ced tathā eva dharma vicāraḥ api kartavyaḥ iti paśyatu bhavān
